In the uXBasic compiler repo at C:\Users\mete\Downloads\BasicOyunSource\UXBc_Clean\UXBc\uxb (a FreeBASIC codebase), compiling/running a uXBasic program that includes a library wrapper `.bas` file with many `CALL(DLL, "somelib.dll", "symbol", ...)` FFI declarations is much slower than it should be, and the slowdown appears worse than linear (possibly worse than quadratic) in the number of declared FFI calls.

Concrete data points from this session (measured via `uxb.exe run <file>.uxb` on a trivial test program, wall-clock via PowerShell Stopwatch, with the FFI allowlist file build/manual/config/ffi_allowlist.txt fully populated so there were no "deny" warnings slowing things down further):
- `libsx/uxraylib/uxraylib.bas` with ~25 functions: a few seconds.
- Same file expanded to ~95 functions: 34-40 seconds.
- Same file expanded further to ~136 functions: 135 seconds (over 2 minutes).

That's roughly a 3.6x time increase for only a 1.4x increase in declared functions — worse than quadratic, and this is BEFORE accounting for the fact that `build/manual/config/ffi_allowlist.txt` (loaded once per run, see `src/runtime/exec/exec_ffi_runtime.fbs`, loaded via a function that reads the file line-by-line into an array `gFfiAllowEntries`) is a PROJECT-WIDE list (currently ~1228 entries across ~80 libraries) that also keeps growing as more libraries get audited via `tools/library_tools/uxb_library_abi.py`. The runtime FFI policy check (look for the function that validates a specific dll+symbol+signature against `gFfiAllowEntries` — likely near "deny-not-allowlisted" in exec_ffi_runtime.fbs, function returns `denyReasonOut`) appears to do a LINEAR SCAN (`For i = ... To ...`) over the full allowlist array for every single CALL(DLL,...) site encountered during compilation/execution. If so, that means total cost scales as O(declared calls in this file × total allowlist size project-wide), which would explain compounding slowdowns as BOTH grow over time — this will keep getting worse for every future user of this compiler, not just for large libraries like raylib/SDL3.

Task: confirm this hypothesis by profiling or reading the actual FFI validation code path (start at `src/runtime/exec/exec_ffi_runtime.fbs`, the function with `denyReasonOut = "deny-not-allowlisted"` near the end doing `For i = ... Next i` over `gFfiAllowEntries`), and if confirmed, fix it — e.g. build a hash/dictionary keyed by (dll, symbol) once after loading the allowlist, instead of re-scanning the full array per call site. Verify the fix by re-running the same kind of test (a program that declares/uses many CALL(DLL,...) sites) and confirming wall-clock time no longer grows superlinearly with declared-call count. This is real performance work — no shortcuts, and don't change the actual allow/deny semantics, only the lookup performance.

## claude-in-chrome
**IMPORTANT: If the Chrome browser tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load them with ToolSearch before calling them, and batch every tool you expect to need into ONE ToolSearch call (the select query accepts a comma-separated list). Do NOT load tools one at a time; each separate ToolSearch call wastes a full round-trip.**

Start a browser task whose tools are not yet loaded with a single call loading the core set:

ToolSearch with query "select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_close_mcp"

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting. Only issue a second ToolSearch if the task later needs a tool you did not anticipate.

- anthropic-skills:docx: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx) or Word templates (.dotx). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file (to download, email or print), use this skill. However, if they ask for a document, page, report, memo, or notes WITHOUT naming a file format and the session offers a dedicated document or page skill or connector, use that instead. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or coding unrelated to document generation.
- anthropic-skills:explain-usage: Explain where this session's tokens went, with one simple chart in plain language. Use when the user says things like "explain my usage", "where did my tokens go", or asks for a usage breakdown.
- anthropic-skills:import-memory: Import a memory export from another AI assistant into Claude's memory — conversationally, additively, and with the content treated as data.
- anthropic-skills:morning: Render the user's morning brief as a styled HTML artifact, or set it up as a recurring weekday task. Use only when the user explicitly asks to run, see, or set up their morning brief, or if they invoke /morning by name. A question about their day, schedule, or calendar is not by itself a request for the brief; answer it directly instead.
- anthropic-skills:pdf: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.
- anthropic-skills:pptx: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations as PowerPoint (.pptx) files; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email, summary, or creating a different type of slide deck); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user asks for a PowerPoint or .pptx file, or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. However, when the user asks for a deck, slides, a slide deck, or a presentation without naming a file format, default to using a dedicated slide-deck artifact type or a separate slides skill if this session offers one; otherwise, use this skill.
- anthropic-skills:schedule: Create or update a scheduled task that runs automatically. Use when the user says things like "every day", "each morning", "remind me in an hour", "run this at noon", or wants to reschedule an existing task.
- anthropic-skills:setup-cowork: Guided setup — install role-matched plugins, connect your tools, try a skill.
- anthropic-skills:skill-creator: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
- anthropic-skills:xlsx: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.
- design: Create a design canvas - a multi-artboard visual design published as an Artifact that runs Claude Design's canvas editor (an early preview of Claude Design inside Claude Code). You DRAFT the design as .dc.html artboards laid out on one pan/zoom canvas; where saving is enabled for the user's account they refine every element visually (click-to-select, a properties panel, inline text editing, undo/redo) and Save publishes a new version for everyone, otherwise they get a view-and-export (PNG/PDF) preview of your draft. Good for UI mockups and screen flows, landing pages, marketing and social graphics, and print pieces - posters, flyers, brochures as single-page artboards; memos and reports as one flowing artboard. Use when someone wants a design, mockup, wireframe, UI or screen design, landing page, poster, flyer, brochure, banner, card, one-pager, or any visual layout they would rather tweak by hand than in code. Only for CREATING or re-seeding a canvas; an existing one is edited in its published Artifact.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Private Function ExecDllCallIsAllowlisted(ByRef dllName As String, ByRef symbolName As String, ByRef signatureText As String, ByRef callingConventionText As String, ByVal requireAttestation As Integer, ByRef denyReasonOut As String) As Integer

Private Function ExecEvalDllCallCore(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal callNodeIdx As Integer, ByRef dllName As String, ByRef symbolName As String, ByRef signatureText As String, ByRef callingConventionText As String, ByVal argStartPos As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim ffiArgCount As Integer
    ffiArgCount = ExecChildCount(ps, callNodeIdx)

    Dim effectiveArgStartPos As Integer
    effectiveArgStartPos = argStartPos

    Dim mixedArgTypes(0 To 15) As String
    Dim mixedArgTypeCount As Integer
    Dim mixedTypeStatus As Integer
    mixedTypeStatus = ExecTryReadDllArgTypeList(ps, callNodeIdx, argStartPos, ffiArgCount, mixedArgTypes(), mixedArgTypeCount, errText)
    If mixedTypeStatus < 0 Then Return 0
    If mixedTypeStatus > 0 Then effectiveArgStartPos = argStartPos + 1

    If signatureText = "BYREF" Then
        Dim byrefNode As Integer
        byrefNode = ExecChildAt(ps, callNodeIdx, effectiveArgStartPos)
        If byrefNode = -1 Or UCase(ps.ast.nodes(byrefNode).kind) <> "IDENT" Then
            errText = "exec: CALL(DLL) BYREF requires addressable target argument (" & LTrim(Str(UXB_FFI_ERR_BYREF_TARGET)) & ")"
            Return 0
        End If
    End If

    Dim ai As Integer
    For ai = effectiveArgStartPos To ffiArgCount - 1
        Dim argNode As Integer
        argNode = ExecChildAt(ps, callNodeIdx, ai)
        If argNode = -1 Then
            errText = "exec: CALL(DLL) argument missing"
            Return 0
        End If

        Dim argSig As String
        If mixedTypeStatus > 0 Then
            argSig = mixedArgTypes(ai - effectiveArgStartPos)
        Else
            ' Legacy calls without an ABI10 type list are integer calls.  The
            ' return signature describes the result, never the argument types.
            argSig = "I32"
        End If

        If ExecValidateDllMarshalArg(ps, es, argNode, argSig, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    Next ai

    Dim denyReason As String
    Dim allowDecision As Integer
    Dim requireAttestation As Integer
    Dim ffiMode As String
    ffiMode = ExecGetFfiPolicyMode()
    requireAttestation = IIf(ffiMode = "ENFORCE", 1, 0)
    allowDecision = ExecDllCallIsAllowlisted(dllName, symbolName, signatureText, callingConventionText, requireAttestation, denyReason)
    ExecAuditDllPolicy dllName, symbolName, signatureText, callingConventionText, ffiMode, allowDecision, denyReason

    If allowDecision = 0 And ffiMode = "ENFORCE" Then
        If denyReason = "deny-policy-load-failed" Then
            errText = "exec: CALL(DLL) denied by policy load failed (" & LTrim(Str(UXB_FFI_ERR_POLICY_LOAD_FAILED)) & ")"
            Return 0
        End If
        If denyReason = "deny-attestation-required" Then
            errText = "exec: CALL(DLL) denied by policy attestation required (" & LTrim(Str(UXB_FFI_ERR_POLICY_ATTEST_REQUIRED)) & ")"
            Return 0
        End If
        If denyReason = "deny-hash-extract-failed" Then
            errText = "exec: CALL(DLL) denied by policy hash extraction failed (" & LTrim(Str(UXB_FFI_ERR_POLICY_HASH_EXTRACT_FAILED)) & ")"
            Return 0
        End If
        If denyReason = "deny-hash-mismatch" Then
            errText = "exec: CALL(DLL) denied by policy hash mismatch (" & LTrim(Str(UXB_FFI_ERR_POLICY_HASH_MISMATCH)) & ")"
            Return 0
        End If
        If denyReason = "deny-signer-extract-failed" Then
            errText = "exec: CALL(DLL) denied by policy signer extraction failed (" & LTrim(Str(UXB_FFI_ERR_POLICY_SIGNER_EXTRACT_FAILED)) & ")"
            Return 0
        End If
        If denyReason = "deny-signer-mismatch" Then
            errText = "exec: CALL(DLL) denied by policy signer mismatch (" & LTrim(Str(UXB_FFI_ERR_POLICY_SIGNER_MISMATCH)) & ")"
            Return 0
        End If
        errText = "exec: CALL(DLL) denied by policy (" & LTrim(Str(UXB_FFI_ERR_POLICY_DENY)) & ")"
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim resolverMode As String
    resolverMode = ExecGetFfiResolverMode()

    Dim ffiArgRuntimeCount As Integer
    ffiArgRuntimeCount = ffiArgCount - effectiveArgStartPos
    If ffiArgRuntimeCount < 0 Then ffiArgRuntimeCount = 0
    If ffiArgRuntimeCount > 10 Then
        errText = "exec: CALL(DLL/API) ABI10 supports at most 10 runtime arguments (" & LTrim(Str(UXB_FFI_ERR_BAD_ARITY)) & ")"

Private Function ExecEvalCall(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal callNameRaw As String, ByVal callNodeIdx As Integer, ByVal expectValue As Integer, ByRef valueOut As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim callName As String
    callName = ExecFix8BCanonName(callNameRaw)
    ' FIX8_STR_NS_INC_FIXED_20260611: CALL_EXPR.value can carry LEFT$/UCASE$ in BASIC-compatible sources.
    If Right(callName, 1) = "$" Then callName = Left(callName, Len(callName) - 1)

    If ExecIsBuiltinCallName(callName) <> 0 Then
        valueOut = ExecEvalBuiltinCall(ps, es, callName, callNodeIdx, errText)
        If errText <> "" Then Return 0
        Return 1
    End If

    If InStr(callName, ".") > 0 Then
        ' HAMLE-2: Hamle-1 parser yamasindan gelen CALL_EXPR.left varsa
        ' metot alicisini string bolerek degil, gercek AST ifadesi olarak cozer.
        Dim receiverMethodRv As Integer
        receiverMethodRv = ExecTryEvalReceiverMethodCall(ps, es, callName, callNodeIdx, expectValue, valueOut, errText)
        If receiverMethodRv >= 0 Then Return receiverMethodRv

        ' Geri uyumluluk: Class.method(), SUPER.method() ve eski parser ciktisi.
        Return ExecEvalMethodCall(ps, es, callName, callNodeIdx, expectValue, valueOut, errText)
    End If

    ' A declared routine wins over the implicit same-named function result
    ' variable. This is required for recursion: FUNCTION F creates an F result
    ' slot, but F(...) must still call the routine instead of MAGIC_CALL.
    If ExecRoutineIndexOf(es, callName) <> -1 Then
        Return ExecEvalUserCall(ps, es, callName, callNodeIdx, expectValue, valueOut, errText)
    End If

    ' Callable object surface: obj(...) dispatches to MAGIC_CALL / __CALL when obj is a class instance.
    Dim magicCallRv As Integer
    magicCallRv = ExecTryEvalMagicCall(ps, es, callName, callNodeIdx, expectValue, valueOut, errText)
    If magicCallRv >= 0 Then Return magicCallRv

    Dim aliasFound As Integer
    Dim aliasTarget As String
    If ExecFindAliasTargetText(ps, callName, ps.ast.nodes(callNodeIdx).lineNo, aliasTarget, aliasFound, errText) = 0 Then
        Return 0
    End If

    If aliasFound <> 0 Then
        Dim aliasKind As String
        Dim aliasDll As String
        Dim aliasSymbol As String
        Dim aliasSig As String
        Dim aliasConv As String

        If ExecTryParseAliasFfiTarget(aliasTarget, aliasKind, aliasDll, aliasSymbol, aliasSig, aliasConv) <> 0 Then
            valueOut = ExecEvalDllCallCore(ps, es, callNodeIdx, aliasDll, aliasSymbol, aliasSig, aliasConv, 0, errText)
            If errText <> "" Then Return 0
            Return 1
        End If

        Dim aliasCallRef As String
        If ExecTryParseAliasCallRef(aliasTarget, aliasCallRef) <> 0 Then
            If aliasCallRef = callName Then
                errText = "exec: ALIAS self-cycle for " & callName
                Return 0
            End If

            gExecAliasResolveDepth += 1
            If gExecAliasResolveDepth > 32 Then
                gExecAliasResolveDepth = 0
                errText = "exec: ALIAS recursion depth exceeded for " & callName
                Return 0
            End If

            Dim aliasRv As Integer
            aliasRv = ExecEvalCall(ps, es, aliasCallRef, callNodeIdx, expectValue, valueOut, errText)
            gExecAliasResolveDepth -= 1
            Return aliasRv
        End If

Private Function ExecFindAliasTargetText(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef aliasUpper As String, ByVal callLineNo As Integer, ByRef targetTextOut As String, ByRef foundOut As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    foundOut = 0
    targetTextOut = ""

    Dim bestAliasNode As Integer
    bestAliasNode = -1
    Dim bestLineNo As Integer
    bestLineNo = -2147483648

    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To ps.ast.count - 1
        Dim n As ASTNode
        n = ps.ast.nodes(i)
        If UCase(n.kind) = "ALIAS_STMT" Then
            If UCase(Trim(n.value)) = aliasUpper Then
                If callLineNo <= 0 Then
                    bestAliasNode = i
                    Exit For
                End If
                If n.lineNo <= callLineNo And n.lineNo >= bestLineNo Then
                    bestAliasNode = i
                    bestLineNo = n.lineNo
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    If bestAliasNode = -1 Then Return 1

    Dim targetNode As Integer
    targetNode = ps.ast.nodes(bestAliasNode).firstChild
    If targetNode = -1 Or UCase(ps.ast.nodes(targetNode).kind) <> "ALIAS_TARGET" Then
        errText = "exec: ALIAS target missing for " & aliasUpper
        Return 0
    End If

    targetTextOut = Trim(ps.ast.nodes(targetNode).value)
    If targetTextOut = "" Then
        errText = "exec: ALIAS target is empty for " & aliasUpper
        Return 0
    End If

    foundOut = 1
    Return 1
End Function

Since the wrapper library's AST size grows with its function count, and this unresolved-call scan is uncached and repeated per call site, we're looking at roughly O(callSites × ast.count). If a smoke test calls each of the 136 wrapper functions just once, that alone produces quadratic behavior — 136 scans over an AST proportional in size to 136 functions.

But checking the numbers more carefully, the actual growth from 95→136 functions (1.4x) produced a 3.6x slowdown, far exceeding the ~2x a pure O(n²) model would predict. That points to something compounding beyond simple quadratic scaling — maybe repeated alias resolution calls per logical call, or array growth patterns like ReDim Preserve during AST construction itself adding its own O(n²) cost on top of the lookup cost. My goal now is to pin down which of these compounding factors is actually responsible.

Now I've identified two separate linear scans: one over the global allowlist (roughly constant size, ~1228 entries) happening once per DLL call evaluation, and a much more concerning one that scans the entire AST every time an unresolved call name needs alias resolution. Private Sub ASTEnsureCapacity(ByRef p As ASTPool, ByVal minSize As Integer)
    If p.capacity >= minSize Then Exit Sub
    Dim newCapacity As Integer = p.capacity

Private Function ASTInferFamily(ByRef kindName As String) As Integer
    If kindName = ASTK_PROGRAM Then Return AST_FAMILY_PROGRAM

    Return AST_FAMILY_UNKNOWN

Sub ExecSetFfiPolicyPath(ByRef pathText As String)
    Dim p As String
    p = Trim(pathText)
    If p = "" Then
        gFfiDefaultPolicyPath = "build/manual/config/ffi_allowlist.txt"
    Else
        gFfiDefaultPolicyPath = p
    End If
    If gActiveRuntimeCtx <> 0 Then gActiveRuntimeCtx->ffiPolicyPath = gFfiDefaultPolicyPath

    If gActiveRuntimeCtx <> 0 Then
        gFfiAllowlistLoaded = 0
        gFfiAllowlistLoadFailed = 0
        gFfiAllowlistLoadFailReason = ""
        gFfiAllowEntryCount = 0
        Erase gFfiAllowEntries
    End If
End Sub

Private Function ExecGetFfiPolicyPath() As String
    If gActiveRuntimeCtx <> 0 Then
        If Trim(gActiveRuntimeCtx->ffiPolicyPath) = "" Then
            gActiveRuntimeCtx->ffiPolicyPath = gFfiDefaultPolicyPath
            If Trim(gActiveRuntimeCtx->ffiPolicyPath) = "" Then gActiveRuntimeCtx->ffiPolicyPath = "build/manual/config/ffi_allowlist.txt"
        End If

#ifndef UXB_SYMBOL_INDEX_FBS
#define UXB_SYMBOL_INDEX_FBS

#include once "symbol_key.fbs"

Type UXBSymbolHashSlot
    used As Integer
    key As String
    symbolIdx As Integer
End Type

Dim Shared gUXBSymHash(Any) As UXBSymbolHashSlot
Dim Shared gUXBSymHashCap As Integer
Dim Shared gUXBSymHashCount As Integer

Private Function UXBSymHashOf(ByRef key As String) As UInteger
    Dim h As UInteger = 2166136261
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To Len(key)
        h = (h Xor Asc(Mid(key, i, 1))) * 16777619
    Next i
    Return h
End Function

Sub UXBSymHashReset()
    gUXBSymHashCap = 4096
    ReDim gUXBSymHash(gUXBSymHashCap - 1)
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To gUXBSymHashCap - 1
        gUXBSymHash(i).used = 0
        gUXBSymHash(i).key = ""
        gUXBSymHash(i).symbolIdx = -1
    Next i
    gUXBSymHashCount = 0
End Sub

Private Function UXBSymHashLoadTooHigh() As Integer
    If gUXBSymHashCap <= 0 Then Return 1
    If gUXBSymHashCount * 100 >= gUXBSymHashCap * 70 Then Return 1
    Return 0
End Function

Private Sub UXBSymHashInsertRaw(ByRef key As String, ByVal symbolIdx As Integer)
    If gUXBSymHashCap <= 0 Then UXBSymHashReset
    Dim baseSlot As UInteger
    baseSlot = UXBSymHashOf(key) Mod gUXBSymHashCap
    Dim probe As Integer
    For probe = 0 To gUXBSymHashCap - 1
        Dim slotPos As Integer
        slotPos = (baseSlot + probe) Mod gUXBSymHashCap
        If gUXBSymHash(slotPos).used = 0 Then
            gUXBSymHash(slotPos).used = 1
            gUXBSymHash(slotPos).key = key
            gUXBSymHash(slotPos).symbolIdx = symbolIdx
            gUXBSymHashCount += 1
            Exit Sub
        End If
        If gUXBSymHash(slotPos).key = key Then
            gUXBSymHash(slotPos).symbolIdx = symbolIdx
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next probe
End Sub

Private Sub UXBSymHashRebuild(ByVal newCap As Integer)
    Dim oldCap As Integer = gUXBSymHashCap
    Dim oldSlots(Any) As UXBSymbolHashSlot
    If oldCap > 0 Then
        ReDim oldSlots(oldCap - 1)
        Dim i As Integer
        For i = 0 To oldCap - 1
            oldSlots(i) = gUXBSymHash(i)
        Next i
    End If

    gUXBSymHashCap = newCap
    ReDim gUXBSymHash(gUXBSymHashCap - 1)
    Dim j As Integer
    For j = 0 To gUXBSymHashCap - 1
        gUXBSymHash(j).used = 0
        gUXBSymHash(j).key = ""
        gUXBSymHash(j).symbolIdx = -1
    Next j
    gUXBSymHashCount = 0

    If oldCap > 0 Then
        Dim k As Integer
        For k = 0 To oldCap - 1
            If oldSlots(k).used <> 0 Then UXBSymHashInsertRaw oldSlots(k).key, oldSlots(k).symbolIdx
        Next k
    End If
End Sub

Sub UXBSymHashInsert(ByVal scopeId As Integer, ByVal nameText As String, ByVal kindText As String, ByVal symbolIdx As Integer)
    If gUXBSymHashCap <= 0 Then UXBSymHashReset
    If UXBSymHashLoadTooHigh() <> 0 Then UXBSymHashRebuild gUXBSymHashCap * 2
    Dim key As String = UXBSymMakeKey(scopeId, nameText, kindText)
    UXBSymHashInsertRaw key, symbolIdx
End Sub

Function UXBSymHashLookupExact(ByVal scopeId As Integer, ByVal nameText As String, ByVal kindText As String) As Integer
    If gUXBSymHashCap <= 0 Then Return -1
    Dim key As String = UXBSymMakeKey(scopeId, nameText, kindText)
    Dim baseSlot As UInteger
    baseSlot = UXBSymHashOf(key) Mod gUXBSymHashCap
    Dim probe As Integer
    For probe = 0 To gUXBSymHashCap - 1
        Dim slotPos As Integer
        slotPos = (baseSlot + probe) Mod gUXBSymHashCap
        If gUXBSymHash(slotPos).used = 0 Then Return -1
        If gUXBSymHash(slotPos).key = key Then Return gUXBSymHash(slotPos).symbolIdx
    Next probe
    Return -1
End Function

#endif

This existing hash table pattern with FNV-1a hashing, linear probing, and load-factor rebuilding is a good template to reuse. I'm planning to build two similar tables: one for the FFI allowlist keyed by a combination of dll, symbol, and signature, storing the symbol index or a marker for multiple matches.

Since multiple entries can share the same dll+symbol+sig key (differing only in convention), I need each key to map to a small ordered list of all matching indices rather than a single value, so I can preserve the original array's relative ordering while only iterating the few relevant candidates instead of the whole allowlist. I'm designing this as a hash table mapping each key to a head index into a separate chain array, similar to a classic hash map with bucket chaining.

Good, entries are already normalized at load time, so I can build the key directly from stored fields without re-normalizing. I'll build the chain index once: an open-addressing hash mapping each key to a chain of matching entry indices via a parallel "next" array initialized to -1, prepending each new entry to its key's chain as I iterate.

Since prepending while scanning i=0..count-1 reverses the traversal order, and the original semantics require scanning strictly in ascending original order until one passes the convention/attestation check, I need to preserve forward order in the chain construction rather than just prepending naively—so I should track the tail per key and append instead, or otherwise reverse the built chain to restore ascending order.

Writing the hash slot struct and build loop...

Then walking only the matching chain, applying the same per-entry checks in order until one passes or the chain ends, falling back to deny-not-allowlisted otherwise. This preserves exact ordering and semantics while limiting iteration to same-key entries, which is the correct optimization for exec_ffi_runtime.fbs. I'm using Chr(1) as the separator between key parts specifically to avoid collisions with characters like "|" that could theoretically appear in dll or symbol names.

Now moving to the second optimization — alias lookup by name across the full AST. I want to build an index once by scanning ps.ast for ALIAS_STMT nodes, keying on the uppercased trimmed alias name, similar to the FFI index but needing to account for redeclaration: multiple ALIAS_STMT nodes can share the same name at different points, so resolution should pick the entry with the highest line number that's still <= the call's line number.

To replicate the original algorithm exactly, I need to store a list of node indices per alias-name key, preserving the original AST scan order (0 to count-1), since the original logic doesn't assume line numbers are strictly ascending across the whole AST — it just iterates all nodes in order and tracks the best-matching preceding line number for each candidate.

I can just iterate over this smaller filtered list using the exact same comparison logic as before—same tie-breaking, same early exit when callLineNo<=0—just scoped to fewer candidates, which preserves identical behavior while being faster.

I'm planning to build the name-to-node-indices map with a single pass over the AST, and cache it with a count check against `ps.ast.count` so it gets rebuilt safely if the AST changes between parses, following the same "build once" pattern used elsewhere but with this extra safety guard since it's internal to execution.

Now I need to locate where the exec_ffi_runtime globals like gFfiAllowEntries and gFfiAllowEntryCount are declared so I can place the new cache globals nearby, and check the surrounding file structure for Type/Dim declarations.

Private Function ExecNormalizeFfiHashToken(ByRef hashIn As String, ByRef hashOut As String) As Integer
    hashOut = UCase(Trim(hashIn))
    If hashOut = "" Then Return 0
    If hashOut = "*" Then Return 1
    If Len(hashOut) <> 64 Then Return 0

    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To Len(hashOut)
        Dim ch As Integer
        ch = Asc(Mid(hashOut, i, 1))
        If (ch >= Asc("0") And ch <= Asc("9")) Or (ch >= Asc("A") And ch <= Asc("F")) Then
            ' valid
        Else
            Return 0
        End If
    Next i

    Return 1
End Function

Private Function ExecNormalizeFfiSignerToken(ByRef signerIn As String, ByRef signerOut As String) As Integer
    signerOut = UCase(Trim(signerIn))
    If signerOut = "" Then Return 0
    If Instr(signerOut, "|") > 0 Then Return 0
    Return 1
End Function

    If gFfiAllowEntryCount = 0 Then
        ReDim gFfiAllowEntries(0)

    gFfiAllowEntries(gFfiAllowEntryCount).dllName = UCase(Trim(dllName))

    gFfiAllowEntries(gFfiAllowEntryCount).signatureText = UCase(Trim(signatureText))
    gFfiAllowEntries(gFfiAllowEntryCount).callingConventionText = UCase(Trim(callingConventionText))
    gFfiAllowEntries(gFfiAllowEntryCount).hashText = UCase(Trim(hashText))
    gFfiAllowEntries(gFfiAllowEntryCount).signerText = UCase(Trim(signerText))
    gFfiAllowEntryCount += 1

Private Sub ExecLoadFfiAllowlistIfNeeded()
    If gFfiAllowlistLoaded <> 0 Then Exit Sub
    gFfiAllowlistLoaded = 1
    gFfiAllowlistLoadFailed = 0
    gFfiAllowlistLoadFailReason = ""
    gFfiAllowEntryCount = 0
    Erase gFfiAllowEntries

    Dim policyPath As String
    policyPath = ExecGetFfiPolicyPath()

    If Dir(policyPath) = "" Then
        If ExecGetFfiPolicyMode() = "ENFORCE" Then
            gFfiAllowlistLoadFailed = 1
            gFfiAllowlistLoadFailReason = "file-not-found"
            UxbWarn "FFI policy file not found, enforce deny path=" & policyPath
        Else
            ExecSeedDefaultFfiAllowlist
            UxbWarn "FFI policy file not found, defaults active path=" & policyPath
        End If
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim f As Integer
    f = FreeFile
    Open policyPath For Input As #f
    If Err <> 0 Then
        If ExecGetFfiPolicyMode() = "ENFORCE" Then
            gFfiAllowlistLoadFailed = 1
            gFfiAllowlistLoadFailReason = "open-failed"
            UxbWarn "FFI policy open failed, enforce deny path=" & policyPath
        Else
            ExecSeedDefaultFfiAllowlist
            UxbWarn "FFI policy open failed, defaults active path=" & policyPath
        End If
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim headerSeen As Integer
    Dim headerValid As Integer
    headerSeen = 0
    headerValid = 0

    Do While Not Eof(f)
        Dim lineText As String
        Line Input #f, lineText

        Dim lineTrim As String
        lineTrim = Trim(lineText)

        If lineTrim <> "" Then
            If headerSeen = 0 Then
                headerSeen = 1

                Dim headerText As String
                headerText = UCase(lineTrim)
                If Left(headerText, 1) = "#" Then
                    headerText = UCase(Trim(Mid(lineTrim, 2)))
                End If

                If headerText <> UXB_FFI_POLICY_HEADER_V1 Then
                    Close #f
                    If ExecGetFfiPolicyMode() = "ENFORCE" Then
                        gFfiAllowlistLoadFailed = 1
                        gFfiAllowlistLoadFailReason = "header-invalid"
                        UxbWarn "FFI policy header invalid, enforce deny path=" & policyPath
                    Else
                        ExecSeedDefaultFfiAllowlist
                        UxbWarn "FFI policy header invalid, defaults active path=" & policyPath
                    End If
                    Exit Sub
                End If

                headerValid = 1
            Else
                Dim dllName As String
                Dim symbolName As String
                Dim signatureText As String
                Dim callingConventionText As String
                Dim hashText As String
                Dim signerText As String
                If ExecParseFfiAllowlistLine(lineText, dllName, symbolName, signatureText, callingConventionText, hashText, signerText) <> 0 Then
                    ExecFfiAllowlistAppend dllName, symbolName, signatureText, callingConventionText, hashText, signerText
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Loop

    Close #f

    If headerValid = 0 Then
        If ExecGetFfiPolicyMode() = "ENFORCE" Then
            gFfiAllowlistLoadFailed = 1
            gFfiAllowlistLoadFailReason = "header-missing"
            UxbWarn "FFI policy header missing, enforce deny path=" & policyPath
        Else
            ExecSeedDefaultFfiAllowlist
            UxbWarn "FFI policy header missing, defaults active path=" & policyPath
        End If
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If gFfiAllowEntryCount = 0 Then
        If ExecGetFfiPolicyMode() = "ENFORCE" Then
            gFfiAllowlistLoadFailed = 1
            gFfiAllowlistLoadFailReason = "no-valid-entries"
            UxbWarn "FFI policy had no valid entries, enforce deny path=" & policyPath
        Else
            ExecSeedDefaultFfiAllowlist
            UxbWarn "FFI policy had no valid entries, defaults active path=" & policyPath

Private Sub ExecFfiAllowlistAppend(ByRef dllName As String, ByRef symbolName As String, ByRef signatureText As String, ByRef callingConventionText As String, ByRef hashText As String, ByRef signerText As String)
    If gFfiAllowEntryCount >= gFfiAllowEntryCap Then
        Dim newCap As Integer
        newCap = gFfiAllowEntryCap
        If newCap < 1 Then newCap = 64
        Do While newCap <= gFfiAllowEntryCount
            newCap *= 2
        Loop
        ReDim Preserve gFfiAllowEntries(newCap - 1)
        gFfiAllowEntryCap = newCap
    End If

    gFfiAllowEntries(gFfiAllowEntryCount).dllName = UCase(Trim(dllName))

Private Function ExecFfiIndexHashOf(ByRef key As String) As UInteger
    Dim h As UInteger = 2166136261
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To Len(key)
        h = (h Xor Asc(Mid(key, i, 1))) * 16777619
    Next i
    Return h
End Function

Private Function ExecFfiIndexKey(ByRef dllKey As String, ByRef symbolKey As String, ByRef sigKey As String) As String
    Return dllKey & Chr(1) & symbolKey & Chr(1) & sigKey
End Function

' Inserts entryIdx under key, appending to the tail of any existing chain so
' lookup visits same-key entries in the original append order (order matters:
' callers stop at the first entry whose calling convention/attestation passes).
Private Sub ExecFfiIndexInsert(ByRef key As String, ByVal entryIdx As Integer)
    Dim baseSlot As UInteger
    baseSlot = ExecFfiIndexHashOf(key) Mod gFfiIndexCap
    Dim probe As Integer
    For probe = 0 To gFfiIndexCap - 1
        Dim slotPos As Integer
        slotPos = (baseSlot + probe) Mod gFfiIndexCap
        If gFfiIndexSlots(slotPos).used = 0 Then
            gFfiIndexSlots(slotPos).used = 1
            gFfiIndexSlots(slotPos).key = key
            gFfiIndexSlots(slotPos).headIdx = entryIdx
            gFfiIndexSlots(slotPos).tailIdx = entryIdx
            gFfiChainNext(entryIdx) = -1
            Exit Sub
        End If
        If gFfiIndexSlots(slotPos).key = key Then
            gFfiChainNext(gFfiIndexSlots(slotPos).tailIdx) = entryIdx
            gFfiChainNext(entryIdx) = -1
            gFfiIndexSlots(slotPos).tailIdx = entryIdx
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next probe
End Sub

Private Function ExecFfiIndexFindHead(ByRef key As String) As Integer
    If gFfiIndexCap <= 0 Then Return -1
    Dim baseSlot As UInteger
    baseSlot = ExecFfiIndexHashOf(key) Mod gFfiIndexCap
    Dim probe As Integer
    For probe = 0 To gFfiIndexCap - 1
        Dim slotPos As Integer
        slotPos = (baseSlot + probe) Mod gFfiIndexCap
        If gFfiIndexSlots(slotPos).used = 0 Then Return -1
        If gFfiIndexSlots(slotPos).key = key Then Return gFfiIndexSlots(slotPos).headIdx
    Next probe
    Return -1
End Function

    If gFfiIndexBuilt <> 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim cap As Integer
    cap = 64
    Do While cap * 100 < gFfiAllowEntryCount * 200

    Loop

    ReDim gFfiIndexSlots(cap - 1)
    Dim s As Integer
    For s = 0 To cap - 1

        gFfiIndexSlots(s).key = ""
        gFfiIndexSlots(s).headIdx = -1
        gFfiIndexSlots(s).tailIdx = -1

    gFfiIndexCap = cap

    Next i

    gFfiIndexBuilt = 1

Private Function ExecAliasIndexHashOf(ByRef key As String) As UInteger
    Dim h As UInteger = 2166136261
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To Len(key)
        h = (h Xor Asc(Mid(key, i, 1))) * 16777619

' Appends nodeIdx to the tail of the chain for key, preserving ascending
' AST-index order within a key (matches the original 0..count-1 scan order).
Private Sub ExecAliasIndexInsert(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef key As String, ByVal nodeIdx As Integer)
    Dim baseSlot As UInteger
    baseSlot = ExecAliasIndexHashOf(key) Mod ps.aliasIndexCap
    Dim probe As Integer
    For probe = 0 To ps.aliasIndexCap - 1
        Dim slotPos As Integer
        slotPos = (baseSlot + probe) Mod ps.aliasIndexCap
        If ps.aliasIndexSlots(slotPos).used = 0 Then
            ps.aliasIndexSlots(slotPos).used = 1
            ps.aliasIndexSlots(slotPos).key = key
            ps.aliasIndexSlots(slotPos).headIdx = nodeIdx
            ps.aliasIndexSlots(slotPos).tailIdx = nodeIdx
            ps.aliasChainNext(nodeIdx) = -1
            Exit Sub
        End If
        If ps.aliasIndexSlots(slotPos).key = key Then
            ps.aliasChainNext(ps.aliasIndexSlots(slotPos).tailIdx) = nodeIdx
            ps.aliasChainNext(nodeIdx) = -1
            ps.aliasIndexSlots(slotPos).tailIdx = nodeIdx
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next probe
End Sub

Private Function ExecAliasIndexFindHead(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef key As String) As Integer
    If ps.aliasIndexCap <= 0 Then Return -1
    Dim baseSlot As UInteger
    baseSlot = ExecAliasIndexHashOf(key) Mod ps.aliasIndexCap
    Dim probe As Integer
    For probe = 0 To ps.aliasIndexCap - 1
        Dim slotPos As Integer
        slotPos = (baseSlot + probe) Mod ps.aliasIndexCap
        If ps.aliasIndexSlots(slotPos).used = 0 Then Return -1
        If ps.aliasIndexSlots(slotPos).key = key Then Return ps.aliasIndexSlots(slotPos).headIdx
    Next probe
    Return -1
End Function

' Builds an alias-name -> ALIAS_STMT-node-chain index over the whole program AST
' once, so resolving CALL(alias) at each call site no longer rescans every AST
' node in the program (previously O(ast size) per call site, compounding badly
' as a library wrapper file's declared-function count grows).
Private Sub ExecBuildAliasIndexIfNeeded(ByRef ps As ParseState)
    If ps.aliasIndexBuilt <> 0 And ps.aliasIndexAstCount = ps.ast.count Then Exit Sub

    Dim cap As Integer
    cap = 64
    Do While cap * 100 < ps.ast.count * 100
        cap *= 2
    Loop

    ReDim ps.aliasIndexSlots(cap - 1)
    Dim s As Integer
    For s = 0 To cap - 1
        ps.aliasIndexSlots(s).used = 0
        ps.aliasIndexSlots(s).key = ""
        ps.aliasIndexSlots(s).headIdx = -1
        ps.aliasIndexSlots(s).tailIdx = -1
    Next s
    ps.aliasIndexCap = cap

    If ps.ast.count > 0 Then
        ReDim ps.aliasChainNext(ps.ast.count - 1)
    End If

    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To ps.ast.count - 1
        If UCase(ps.ast.nodes(i).kind) = "ALIAS_STMT" Then
            Dim key As String
            key = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).value))
            ExecAliasIndexInsert ps, key, i
        End If
    Next i

    ps.aliasIndexBuilt = 1
    ps.aliasIndexAstCount = ps.ast.count
End Sub

Private Function ExecFindAliasTargetText(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef aliasUpper As String, ByVal callLineNo As Integer, ByRef targetTextOut As String, ByRef foundOut As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    foundOut = 0
    targetTextOut = ""

    ExecBuildAliasIndexIfNeeded ps

    Dim bestAliasNode As Integer
    bestAliasNode = -1
    Dim bestLineNo As Integer
    bestLineNo = -2147483648

    Dim i As Integer
    i = ExecAliasIndexFindHead(ps, aliasUpper)
    Do While i <> -1
        Dim n As ASTNode
        n = ps.ast.nodes(i)
        If callLineNo <= 0 Then
            bestAliasNode = i
            Exit Do
        End If
        If n.lineNo <= callLineNo And n.lineNo >= bestLineNo Then
            bestAliasNode = i
            bestLineNo = n.lineNo
        End If
        i = ps.aliasChainNext(i)
    Loop

    If bestAliasNode = -1 Then Return 1

End Function

Private Function ExecRoutineIndexOf(ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef needle As String) As Integer
    ' FIX8_STR_NS_INC_FIXED_20260611: routine lookup must be case-insensitive and tolerate namespace separators.
    Dim n As String
    n = UCase(Trim(needle))
    Dim nAlt As String
    nAlt = n
    If InStr(nAlt, ".") > 0 Then
        Dim p As Integer
        For p = 1 To Len(nAlt)
            If Mid(nAlt, p, 1) = "." Then Mid(nAlt, p, 1) = "_"
        Next p
    End If

    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To es.runtime.routineDefCount - 1
        Dim r As String
        r = UCase(Trim(es.runtime.routineDefs(i).nameText))
        If r = n Then Return i
        If r = nAlt Then Return i
    Next i
    Return -1
End Function

Private Function ExecMagicNaturalAliasName(ByRef classNameRaw As String, ByRef methodNameRaw As String, ByRef aliasOut As String) As Integer
    ' FIX15_MAGIC_DISPATCH_COMPLETION_20260611:
    ' MAGIC HASH is stored as MAGIC_HASH.  Register a non-authoritative natural
    ' alias CLASS_HASH only if no real CLASS_HASH method exists. This makes older
    ' AST/MIR/codegen paths that know only natural method names still land on the
    ' magic routine, while a real METHOD HASH keeps priority.
    aliasOut = ""
    Dim className As String
    Dim methodName As String
    className = UCase(Trim(classNameRaw))
    methodName = UCase(Trim(methodNameRaw))
    If className = "" Or methodName = "" Then Return 0
    If Left(methodName, 6) <> "MAGIC_" Then Return 0

    Dim natural As String

content.thinking:
I've confirmed the real dominant bottleneck: ExecRoutineIndexOf performs a linear scan over every declared routine for each call, and since routine count grows with every FUNCTION/SUB in the wrapper file, this scan happens repeatedly for recursive lookups and every function call.

This gives O(N²) lookup cost when the test file calls each of N wrapper functions once, perfectly matching the superlinear growth seen in the benchmark. Unlike my earlier ALIAS-index fix, which is still valid for programs using ALIAS declarations but doesn't explain uxraylib.bas's slowdown, this routine-lookup issue is the actual smoking gun since that file uses plain FUNCTION/SUB wrappers with no ALIAS statements at all.

I need to update the user with this finding and apply the same hash-index fix to the routine lookup — building an index over the routine definitions keyed by name and its underscore-normalized variant. Private Function ExecRoutineHashOf(ByRef key As String) As UInteger
    Dim h As UInteger = 2166136261
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To Len(key)
        h = (h Xor Asc(Mid(key, i, 1))) * 16777619
    Next i

Private Sub ExecRoutineIndexReset(ByRef es As ExecState)
    es.runtime.routineIndexCap = 1024
    ReDim es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(es.runtime.routineIndexCap - 1)
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To es.runtime.routineIndexCap - 1
        es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(i).used = 0
        es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(i).key = ""
        es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(i).idx = -1
    Next i
    es.runtime.routineIndexCount = 0
End Sub

Private Function ExecRoutineIndexLoadTooHigh(ByRef es As ExecState) As Integer
    If es.runtime.routineIndexCap <= 0 Then Return 1
    If es.runtime.routineIndexCount * 100 >= es.runtime.routineIndexCap * 70 Then Return 1
    Return 0
End Function

Private Sub ExecRoutineIndexInsertRaw(ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef key As String, ByVal idx As Integer)
    Dim baseSlot As UInteger
    baseSlot = ExecRoutineHashOf(key) Mod es.runtime.routineIndexCap
    Dim probe As Integer
    For probe = 0 To es.runtime.routineIndexCap - 1
        Dim slotPos As Integer
        slotPos = (baseSlot + probe) Mod es.runtime.routineIndexCap
        If es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).used = 0 Then
            es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).used = 1
            es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).key = key
            es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).idx = idx
            es.runtime.routineIndexCount += 1
            Exit Sub
        End If
        If es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).key = key Then
            es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).idx = idx
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next probe
End Sub

Private Sub ExecRoutineIndexRebuild(ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal newCap As Integer)
    Dim oldCap As Integer = es.runtime.routineIndexCap
    Dim oldSlots(Any) As ExecRoutineIndexSlot
    If oldCap > 0 Then
        ReDim oldSlots(oldCap - 1)
        Dim i As Integer
        For i = 0 To oldCap - 1
            oldSlots(i) = es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(i)
        Next i
    End If

    es.runtime.routineIndexCap = newCap
    ReDim es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(es.runtime.routineIndexCap - 1)
    Dim j As Integer
    For j = 0 To es.runtime.routineIndexCap - 1
        es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(j).used = 0
        es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(j).key = ""
        es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(j).idx = -1
    Next j
    es.runtime.routineIndexCount = 0

    If oldCap > 0 Then
        Dim k As Integer
        For k = 0 To oldCap - 1
            If oldSlots(k).used <> 0 Then ExecRoutineIndexInsertRaw es, oldSlots(k).key, oldSlots(k).idx
        Next k
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub ExecRoutineIndexInsert(ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef key As String, ByVal idx As Integer)
    If es.runtime.routineIndexCap <= 0 Then ExecRoutineIndexReset es
    If ExecRoutineIndexLoadTooHigh(es) <> 0 Then ExecRoutineIndexRebuild es, es.runtime.routineIndexCap * 2
    ExecRoutineIndexInsertRaw es, key, idx
End Sub

Private Function ExecRoutineIndexLookup(ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef key As String) As Integer
    If es.runtime.routineIndexCap <= 0 Then Return -1
    Dim baseSlot As UInteger
    baseSlot = ExecRoutineHashOf(key) Mod es.runtime.routineIndexCap
    Dim probe As Integer
    For probe = 0 To es.runtime.routineIndexCap - 1
        Dim slotPos As Integer
        slotPos = (baseSlot + probe) Mod es.runtime.routineIndexCap
        If es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).used = 0 Then Return -1
        If es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).key = key Then Return es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).idx
    Next probe
    Return -1
End Function

Private Function ExecRoutineIndexOf(ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef needle As String) As Integer
    ' FIX8_STR_NS_INC_FIXED_20260611: routine lookup must be case-insensitive and tolerate namespace separators.
    Dim n As String
    n = UCase(Trim(needle))
    Dim nAlt As String
    nAlt = n
    If InStr(nAlt, ".") > 0 Then
        Dim p As Integer
        For p = 1 To Len(nAlt)
            If Mid(nAlt, p, 1) = "." Then Mid(nAlt, p, 1) = "_"
        Next p
    End If

    Dim found As Integer
    found = ExecRoutineIndexLookup(es, n)
    If found <> -1 Then Return found
    If nAlt <> n Then Return ExecRoutineIndexLookup(es, nAlt)
    Return -1
End Function

Private Function ExecRoutineIndexLoadTooHigh(ByRef es As ExecState) As Integer
    If es.runtime.routineIndexCap <= 0 Then Return 1
    If es.runtime.routineIndexCount * 100 >= es.runtime.routineIndexCap * 70 Then Return 1

Private Sub ExecRoutineIndexInsertRaw(ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef key As String, ByVal idx As Integer)
    Dim baseSlot As UInteger
    baseSlot = ExecRoutineHashOf(key) Mod es.runtime.routineIndexCap
    Dim probe As Integer
    For probe = 0 To es.runtime.routineIndexCap - 1
        Dim slotPos As Integer
        slotPos = (baseSlot + probe) Mod es.runtime.routineIndexCap
        If es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).used = 0 Then
            es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).used = 1
            es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).key = key
            es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).idx = idx
            es.runtime.routineIndexCount += 1
            Exit Sub
        End If
        If es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).key = key Then
            es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).idx = idx
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next probe
End Sub

Private Sub ExecRoutineIndexRebuild(ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal newCap As Integer)
    Dim oldCap As Integer = es.runtime.routineIndexCap
    Dim oldSlots(Any) As ExecRoutineIndexSlot
    If oldCap > 0 Then
        ReDim oldSlots(oldCap - 1)
        Dim i As Integer
        For i = 0 To oldCap - 1
            oldSlots(i) = es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(i)
        Next i
    End If

    es.runtime.routineIndexCap = newCap
    ReDim es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(es.runtime.routineIndexCap - 1)
    Dim j As Integer
    For j = 0 To es.runtime.routineIndexCap - 1
        es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(j).used = 0
        es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(j).key = ""
        es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(j).idx = -1
    Next j
    es.runtime.routineIndexCount = 0

    If oldCap > 0 Then
        Dim k As Integer
        For k = 0 To oldCap - 1
            If oldSlots(k).used <> 0 Then ExecRoutineIndexInsertRaw es, oldSlots(k).key, oldSlots(k).idx
        Next k
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub ExecRoutineIndexInsert(ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef key As String, ByVal idx As Integer)
    If es.runtime.routineIndexCap <= 0 Then ExecRoutineIndexReset es
    If ExecRoutineIndexLoadTooHigh(es) <> 0 Then ExecRoutineIndexRebuild es, es.runtime.routineIndexCap * 2
    ExecRoutineIndexInsertRaw es, key, idx
End Sub

Private Function ExecRoutineIndexLookup(ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef key As String) As Integer
    If es.runtime.routineIndexCap <= 0 Then Return -1
    Dim baseSlot As UInteger
    baseSlot = ExecRoutineHashOf(key) Mod es.runtime.routineIndexCap
    Dim probe As Integer
    For probe = 0 To es.runtime.routineIndexCap - 1
        Dim slotPos As Integer
        slotPos = (baseSlot + probe) Mod es.runtime.routineIndexCap
        If es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).used = 0 Then Return -1
        If es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).key = key Then Return es.runtime.routineIndexSlots(slotPos).idx
    Next probe
    Return -1
End Function

Private Function ExecRoutineIndexOf(ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef needle As String) As Integer
    ' FIX8_STR_NS_INC_FIXED_20260611: routine lookup must be case-insensitive and tolerate namespace separators.
    Dim n As String
    n = UCase(Trim(needle))
    Dim nAlt As String
    nAlt = n
    If InStr(nAlt, ".") > 0 Then
        Dim p As Integer
        For p = 1 To Len(nAlt)
            If Mid(nAlt, p, 1) = "." Then Mid(nAlt, p, 1) = "_"
        Next p
    End If

    Dim found As Integer
    found = ExecRoutineIndexLookup(es, n)
    If found <> -1 Then Return found
    If nAlt <> n Then Return ExecRoutineIndexLookup(es, nAlt)
    Return -1
End Function

Private Function ExecRegisterRoutineDef(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal nodeIdx As Integer, ByRef routineNameRaw As String, ByRef routineKindRaw As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim routineName As String
    Dim routineKind As String
    routineName = UCase(Trim(routineNameRaw))
    routineKind = UCase(Trim(routineKindRaw))
    If routineName = "" Then
        errText = "exec: routine name missing"
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim existingIdx As Integer
    existingIdx = ExecRoutineIndexOf(es, routineName)
    If existingIdx <> -1 Then
        Dim existingKind As String
        Dim existingIsImpl As Integer
        Dim newIsImpl As Integer

        existingKind = UCase(Trim(es.runtime.routineDefs(existingIdx).routineKind))
        existingIsImpl = IIf(existingKind = "SUB_STMT" Or existingKind = "FUNCTION_STMT" Or existingKind = "EVENT_STMT" Or existingKind = "PIPE_STMT" Or existingKind = "THREAD_STMT" Or existingKind = "PARALEL_STMT", 1, 0)
        newIsImpl = IIf(routineKind = "SUB_STMT" Or routineKind = "FUNCTION_STMT" Or routineKind = "EVENT_STMT" Or routineKind = "PIPE_STMT" Or routineKind = "THREAD_STMT" Or routineKind = "PARALEL_STMT", 1, 0)

        ' CLASS METHOD declaration and top-level implementation can legally share
        ' the same canonical symbol (e.g. BOX_SETBYTHIS). Prefer implementation.
        If (existingKind = "CLASS_METHOD_DECL" Or existingKind = "CLASS_OPERATOR_DECL") And newIsImpl <> 0 Then
            es.runtime.routineDefs(existingIdx).nodeIdx = nodeIdx
            es.runtime.routineDefs(existingIdx).routineKind = routineKind
            Return 1
        End If

        If existingIsImpl <> 0 And (routineKind = "CLASS_METHOD_DECL" Or routineKind = "CLASS_OPERATOR_DECL") Then
            Return 1
        End If

        errText = "exec: duplicate routine " & routineName
        Return 0
    End If

    If es.runtime.routineDefCount = 0 Then
        ReDim es.runtime.routineDefs(0)
    Else
        ReDim Preserve es.runtime.routineDefs(es.runtime.routineDefCount)
    End If

    es.runtime.routineDefs(es.runtime.routineDefCount).nameText = routineName
    es.runtime.routineDefs(es.runtime.routineDefCount).nodeIdx = nodeIdx
    es.runtime.routineDefs(es.runtime.routineDefCount).routineKind = routineKind
    es.runtime.routineDefCount += 1
    Return 1
End Function

'   "I32,I32->I32"
'   "(I32, F64) -> VOID"
'   "VOID"

' UXB_FFI_CONTRACT_FIX_20260728: executable CALL(DLL/API) ABI is ABI10.
Const UXB_FFI_MAX_ARGS As Integer = 10

Type UXBFFITypeSpec
    name As String
    sizeBytes As Integer
    abiClass As String  ' INT, FLOAT, PTR, VOID
End Type

Type UXBFFISignature
    rawText As String
    returnType As UXBFFITypeSpec
    args(0 To UXB_FFI_MAX_ARGS - 1) As UXBFFITypeSpec
    argCount As Integer
    ok As Integer
    errorText As String
End Type

Function UXBFFITrimUpper(ByRef s As String) As String
    Return UCase(Trim(s))
End Function

Function UXBFFITypeFromName(ByRef typeName As String, ByRef outType As UXBFFITypeSpec, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim t As String
    t = UXBFFITrimUpper(typeName)
    errText = ""

    Select Case t
    Case "I32", "U32", "F32"
        outType.name = t
        outType.sizeBytes = 4
    Case "I64", "U64", "F64", "PTR", "STRPTR", "WSTRPTR"
        outType.name = t
        outType.sizeBytes = 8
    Case "VOID"
        outType.name = t
        outType.sizeBytes = 0
    Case Else
        errText = "FFI_SIGNATURE_ERROR: unknown type '" & typeName & "'"
        Return 0
    End Select

    Select Case t
    Case "F32", "F64"
        outType.abiClass = "FLOAT"
    Case "PTR", "STRPTR", "WSTRPTR"
        outType.abiClass = "PTR"
    Case "VOID"
        outType.abiClass = "VOID"
    Case Else
        outType.abiClass = "INT"
    End Select

    Return 1
End Function

Private Function UXBFFIStripParens(ByRef s As String) As String
    Dim t As String
    t = Trim(s)
    If Len(t) >= 2 Then
        If Left(t, 1) = "(" And Right(t, 1) = ")" Then
            Return Trim(Mid(t, 2, Len(t) - 2))
        End If
    End If
    Return t
End Function

Private Function UXBFFIArgTokenAt(ByRef argText As String, ByVal wantedIndex As Integer) As String
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim startPos As Integer
    Dim idx As Integer
    startPos = 1
    idx = 0

    For i = 1 To Len(argText) + 1
        If i > Len(argText) Or Mid(argText, i, 1) = "," Then
            If idx = wantedIndex Then Return Trim(Mid(argText, startPos, i - startPos))
            idx += 1
            startPos = i + 1
        End If
    Next i
    Return ""
End Function

Private Function UXBFFICountArgs(ByRef argText As String) As Integer
    Dim t As String
    t = Trim(argText)
    If t = "" Or UCase(t) = "VOID" Then Return 0
    Dim n As Integer
    Dim i As Integer
    n = 1
    For i = 1 To Len(t)
        If Mid(t, i, 1) = "," Then n += 1
    Next i
    Return n
End Function

Sub UXBFFISignatureInit(ByRef sig As UXBFFISignature)
    sig.rawText = ""
    sig.argCount = 0
    sig.ok = 0
    sig.errorText = ""
    sig.returnType.name = "VOID"
    sig.returnType.sizeBytes = 0
    sig.returnType.abiClass = "VOID"
End Sub

Function UXBFFIParseSignature(ByRef signatureText As String, ByRef sig As UXBFFISignature) As Integer
    UXBFFISignatureInit sig
    sig.rawText = Trim(signatureText)

    If sig.rawText = "" Then
        sig.errorText = "FFI_SIGNATURE_ERROR: empty signature"
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim leftPart As String
    Dim rightPart As String
    Dim arrowPos As Integer
    arrowPos = InStr(sig.rawText, "->")

    If arrowPos <= 0 Then
        leftPart = ""
        rightPart = sig.rawText
    Else
        leftPart = Trim(Left(sig.rawText, arrowPos - 1))
        rightPart = Trim(Mid(sig.rawText, arrowPos + 2))
    End If

    Dim errText As String
    If UXBFFITypeFromName(rightPart, sig.returnType, errText) = 0 Then
        sig.errorText = errText
        Return 0
    End If

    leftPart = UXBFFIStripParens(leftPart)
    Dim argc As Integer
    argc = UXBFFICountArgs(leftPart)
    If argc > UXB_FFI_MAX_ARGS Then
        sig.errorText = "FFI_SIGNATURE_ERROR: too many arguments, max=" & LTrim(Str(UXB_FFI_MAX_ARGS))
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To argc - 1
        Dim tok As String
        tok = UXBFFIArgTokenAt(leftPart, i)
        If tok = "" Then
            sig.errorText = "FFI_SIGNATURE_ERROR: empty argument type at index " & LTrim(Str(i))
            Return 0
        End If
        If UXBFFITypeFromName(tok, sig.args(i), errText) = 0 Then
            sig.errorText = errText
            Return 0
        End If
        If sig.args(i).abiClass = "VOID" Then
            sig.errorText = "FFI_SIGNATURE_ERROR: VOID cannot be used as argument type"
            Return 0
        End If
    Next i

    sig.argCount = argc
    sig.ok = 1
    Return 1
End Function

Function UXBFFICallingConventionValid(ByRef convText As String, ByRef targetText As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim c As String
    Dim t As String
    c = UXBFFITrimUpper(convText)
    t = UXBFFITrimUpper(targetText)
    If c = "" Then c = "CDECL"

    Select Case c
    Case "CDECL", "STDCALL", "WIN64", "SYSTEM", "API"
        ' accepted names
    Case Else
        errText = "FFI_CALL_CONV_ERROR: unsupported convention '" & convText & "'"
        Return 0
    End Select

    If t = "X64" Or t = "NATIVE" Then
        If c = "STDCALL" Then
            ' On Win64 convention is unified. Keep as accepted but reportable.
            Return 1
        End If
    End If

    Return 1
End Function

Function UXBFFISignatureToText(ByRef sig As UXBFFISignature) As String
    Dim s As String
    Dim i As Integer
    s = "("
    For i = 0 To sig.argCount - 1
        If i > 0 Then s &= ","
        s &= sig.args(i).name
    Next i
    s &= ")->" & sig.returnType.name
    Return s
End Function

    opText = UCase(Trim(opTextRaw))
    leftType = UXBStep3TypeCanonical(leftTypeRaw)
    rightType = UXBStep3TypeCanonical(rightTypeRaw)

    Select Case opText
    Case "+="
        If UXBStep3TypeIsString(leftType) <> 0 Then
            errText = ""
            Return 1
        End If
        If UXBStep3TypeIsNumeric(leftType) = 0 Or UXBStep3TypeIsNumeric(rightType) = 0 Then
            errText = "type: numeric operands required for compound assignment " & opText
            Return 0
        End If
    Case "-=", "*=", "/=", "**="
        If UXBStep3TypeIsNumeric(leftType) = 0 Or UXBStep3TypeIsNumeric(rightType) = 0 Then
            errText = "type: numeric operands required for compound assignment " & opText
            Return 0
        End If
    Case "\=", "%=", "&=", "|=", "^=", "<<=", ">>=", "ROL=", "ROR="
        If UXBStep3TypeIsInteger(leftType) = 0 Or UXBStep3TypeIsInteger(rightType) = 0 Then

' uXBasic raylib + raygui scalar C ABI wrapper.
' Struct-heavy upstream calls are flattened by uxraylib.dll.
NAMESPACE uxraylib

CONST KEY_ESCAPE = 256
CONST KEY_SPACE = 32
CONST KEY_RIGHT = 262
CONST KEY_LEFT = 263
CONST KEY_DOWN = 264
CONST KEY_UP = 265
CONST KEY_A = 65
CONST KEY_D = 68
CONST KEY_S = 83
CONST KEY_W = 87

FUNCTION AdapterVersion() AS I32
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_adapter_version", I32, CDECL)
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION RaylibVersion() AS STRING
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_raylib_version", STRPTR, CDECL)
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION RayguiVersion() AS STRING
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_raygui_version", STRPTR, CDECL)
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION RectangleArea(width AS F64, height AS F64) AS F64
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_rectangle_area", F64, CDECL, "F64,F64", width, height)
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION ColorRGBA(r AS I32, g AS I32, b AS I32, a AS I32) AS U32
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_color_rgba", U32, CDECL, "I32,I32,I32,I32", r, g, b, a)
END FUNCTION
SUB InitWindow(width AS I32, height AS I32, title AS STRING)
    CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_init_window", VOID, CDECL, "I32,I32,STRPTR", width, height, title)
END SUB
FUNCTION WindowShouldClose() AS I32
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_window_should_close", I32, CDECL)
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION WindowReady() AS I32
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_window_ready", I32, CDECL)
END FUNCTION
SUB SetTargetFPS(fps AS I32)

END SUB
END NAMESPACE

Type LexerState
    sourceText As String
    sourceFile As String
    preprocessFailed As Integer
    preprocessError As String
    cursor As Integer
    lineNo As Integer
    colNo As Integer
    tokens As TokenList
    diagnostics As LexerDiagnosticList
End Type

Private Function IsAlpha(ByVal ch As String) As Integer
    If ch = "" Then Return 0
    Dim code As Integer
    code = Asc(ch)
    Return (code >= Asc("A") And code <= Asc("Z")) Or (code >= Asc("a") And code <= Asc("z"))
End Function

Private Function IsDigit(ByVal ch As String) As Integer
    If ch = "" Then Return 0
    Dim code As Integer
    code = Asc(ch)
    Return code >= Asc("0") And code <= Asc("9")
End Function

Private Function IsHexDigit(ByVal ch As String) As Integer
    If IsDigit(ch) <> 0 Then Return 1
    If ch = "" Then Return 0
    Dim code As Integer
    code = Asc(UCase(ch))
    Return code >= Asc("A") And code <= Asc("F")
End Function

Private Function IsBinDigit(ByVal ch As String) As Integer
    Return ch = "0" Or ch = "1"
End Function

Private Function IsOctDigit(ByVal ch As String) As Integer
    If ch = "" Then Return 0
    Dim code As Integer
    code = Asc(ch)
    Return code >= Asc("0") And code <= Asc("7")
End Function

Private Function IsIdentStart(ByVal ch As String) As Integer
    Return IsAlpha(ch) Or ch = "_"
End Function

Private Function IsIdentPart(ByVal ch As String) As Integer
    Return IsIdentStart(ch) Or IsDigit(ch)
End Function

Private Function IsHorizontalWs(ByVal ch As String) As Integer
    Return ch = " " Or ch = Chr(9) Or ch = Chr(13)
End Function

Private Function AtEnd(ByRef st As LexerState) As Integer
    Return st.cursor > Len(st.sourceText)
End Function

#ifndef UXBASIC_LEXER_DIAGNOSTICS_FBS
#define UXBASIC_LEXER_DIAGNOSTICS_FBS

Type LexerDiagnostic
    code As String
    message As String
    sourceFile As String
    lineNo As Integer
    colNo As Integer
End Type

Type LexerDiagnosticList
    items(Any) As LexerDiagnostic
    count As Integer
    capacity As Integer
End Type

Sub LexerDiagnosticListInit(ByRef d As LexerDiagnosticList)
    d.capacity = 8
    ReDim d.items(d.capacity - 1)
    d.count = 0
End Sub

Private Sub LexerDiagnosticEnsure(ByRef d As LexerDiagnosticList, ByVal needCount As Integer)
    If d.capacity >= needCount Then Exit Sub
    Dim cap As Integer = d.capacity
    If cap < 1 Then cap = 1
    Do While cap < needCount
        cap *= 2
    Loop
    ReDim Preserve d.items(cap - 1)
    d.capacity = cap
End Sub

Sub LexerDiagnosticAdd(ByRef d As LexerDiagnosticList, ByRef codeText As String, ByRef msgText As String, ByRef fileText As String, ByVal lineValue As Integer, ByVal colValue As Integer)
    LexerDiagnosticEnsure d, d.count + 1
    d.items(d.count).code = UCase(Trim(codeText))
    d.items(d.count).message = msgText
    d.items(d.count).sourceFile = fileText
    d.items(d.count).lineNo = lineValue
    d.items(d.count).colNo = colValue
    d.count += 1
End Sub

#endif

Private Function LexerAtRemCommentStartFix14(ByRef st As LexerState) As Integer
    ' FIX14_REM_COMMENT_20260611:
    ' BASIC REM satir yorumudur. Daha once lexer yalniz tek tirnak yorumunu
    ' atliyordu; "REM PACKAGE: ..." satirlari tokenlere bolunup parser
    ' hatasina dusuyordu. REM sadece satir/statement basinda ve arkasindan
    ' bosluk/EOL gelirse yorum kabul edilir. Boylece degisken adi "remote"
    ' veya "remarkValue" yanlislikla yorum olmaz.
    If UCase(PeekCh(st)) <> "R" Then Return 0
    If UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) <> "E" Then Return 0
    If UCase(PeekChEx(st, 2)) <> "M" Then Return 0

    Dim afterRem As String
    afterRem = PeekChEx(st, 3)
    If afterRem <> "" And afterRem <> " " And afterRem <> Chr(9) And afterRem <> Chr(10) And afterRem <> Chr(13) Then Return 0

    Dim p As Integer
    p = st.cursor - 1
    Do While p >= 1
        Dim prevCh As String
        prevCh = Mid(st.sourceText, p, 1)
        If prevCh = Chr(10) Or prevCh = Chr(13) Then Return 1
        If prevCh = ":" Then Return 1
        If prevCh <> " " And prevCh <> Chr(9) Then Return 0
        p -= 1
    Loop

    Return 1
End Function

Private Sub LexSource(ByRef st As LexerState)
    Dim ch As String
    Do While Not AtEnd(st)
        ch = PeekCh(st)

        If ch = Chr(13) Then
            If PeekChEx(st, 1) = Chr(10) Then
                st.cursor += 1
            Else
                AdvanceCh st, ch
            End If
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = "_" Then
            If TryConsumeLineContinuation(st) <> 0 Then
                Continue Do
            End If
        End If

        If ch = Chr(10) Then
            PushTok st, "EOL", "", st.lineNo, st.colNo
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = " " Or ch = Chr(9) Then
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = "'" Then
            SkipComment st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If LexerAtRemCommentStartFix14(st) <> 0 Then
            SkipComment st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = Chr(34) Then
            ReadStringLiteral st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If IsDigit(ch) Or (ch = "&" And (UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "H" Or UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "O")) Or (ch = "%" And UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "B") Then
            ReadNumber st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If IsIdentStart(ch) Then
            ReadIdentifier st
            Continue Do
        End If

        ReadOperatorOrPunct st
    Loop

    PushTok st, "EOF", "", st.lineNo, st.colNo
End Sub

Sub LexerInitFromPreprocessed(ByRef st As LexerState, ByRef src As String, ByVal sourcePath As String = "")
    st.sourceFile = sourcePath
    st.sourceText = src
    st.preprocessFailed = 0
    st.preprocessError = ""
    st.cursor = 1
    st.lineNo = 1
    st.colNo = 1
    TokenListInit st.tokens
    LexerDiagnosticListInit st.diagnostics
    LexSource st
End Sub

Sub LexerInit(ByRef st As LexerState, ByRef src As String, ByVal sourcePath As String = "")
    ' Katman ayrimi: LexerInit artik preprocessor calistirmaz.
    ' Ham veya zaten hazir kaynak metni tokenlere ayirir.
    ' Ana yol: PreprocessRun() -> LexerInitFromPreprocessed().
    LexerInitFromPreprocessed st, src, sourcePath
End Sub

Sub LexerInitWithLegacyPreprocess(ByRef st As LexerState, ByRef src As String, ByVal sourcePath As String = "")
    ' Geriye uyumluluk yolu. Yeni kod bu fonksiyonu kullanmamalidir.
    Dim pp As PreprocessResult
    If LexerPreprocessSourceEx(src, sourcePath, pp) = 0 Then
        LexerInitFromPreprocessed st, pp.expandedSource, sourcePath
        st.preprocessFailed = 1
        st.preprocessError = LexerPreprocessGetError()
        If Trim(st.preprocessError) = "" Then st.preprocessError = "preprocess failed"
        LexerAddDiagnostic st, "LEX_PREPROCESS_LEGACY_DEPRECATED", "LexerInitWithLegacyPreprocess deprecated; use PreprocessRun before lexer", 1, 1
        LexerAddDiagnostic st, "LEX_PREPROCESS_FAILED", st.preprocessError, 1, 1
        Exit Sub
    End If

    LexerInitFromPreprocessed st, pp.expandedSource, sourcePath
    LexerAddDiagnostic st, "LEX_PREPROCESS_LEGACY_DEPRECATED", "LexerInitWithLegacyPreprocess deprecated; use PreprocessRun before lexer", 1, 1
End Sub

Sub TokenListPushEx( _
    ByRef t As TokenList, _
    ByVal k As String, _
    ByVal rawText As String, _
    ByVal canonicalText As String, _
    ByVal ln As Integer, _
    ByVal cn As Integer, _
    ByVal sourceFileText As String = "", _
    ByVal offsetValue As Integer = 0, _
    ByVal lengthValue As Integer = 0, _
    ByVal numericBaseText As String = "", _
    ByVal numericSuffixText As String = "" _
)
    TokenListEnsureCapacity t, t.count + 1

    If canonicalText = "" Then canonicalText = rawText
    If lengthValue <= 0 Then lengthValue = Len(rawText)

    t.items(t.count).kind = k
    t.items(t.count).tokKind = TokKindFromString(k)
    t.items(t.count).lexeme = canonicalText
    t.items(t.count).rawLexeme = rawText
    t.items(t.count).canonicalLexeme = canonicalText
    t.items(t.count).lineNo = ln
    t.items(t.count).colNo = cn
    t.items(t.count).sourceFile = sourceFileText
    t.items(t.count).offset = offsetValue
    t.items(t.count).length = lengthValue
    t.items(t.count).lexemeLength = lengthValue
    t.items(t.count).numericBase = numericBaseText
    t.items(t.count).numericSuffix = numericSuffixText
    t.count += 1
End Sub

Sub TokenListPush(ByRef t As TokenList, ByVal k As String, ByVal lx As String, ByVal ln As Integer, ByVal cn As Integer, ByVal sourceFileText As String = "")
    TokenListPushEx t, k, lx, lx, ln, cn, sourceFileText, 0, Len(lx)
End Sub

Sub TokenListClear(ByRef t As TokenList)
    t.count = 0

Private Sub ReadIdentifier(ByRef st As LexerState)
    Dim ln As Integer, cn As Integer
    ln = st.lineNo
    cn = st.colNo

    Dim s As String, ch As String
    Do While Not AtEnd(st)
        ch = PeekCh(st)
        If IsIdentPart(ch) Then
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            s &= ch
        Else
            Exit Do
        End If
    Loop

    Dim identCanonical As String
    identCanonical = CanonicalIdentifier(s)

    If (identCanonical = "rol" Or identCanonical = "ror") And PeekCh(st) = "=" Then
        AdvanceCh st, ch
        PushTokRaw st, "OP", s & "=", UCase(identCanonical) & "=", ln, cn, st.cursor - Len(s) - 1
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim retiredThreadAlias As String
    Dim retiredParalelAlias As String
    Dim retiredMagicAlias As String
    retiredThreadAlias = "th" & "reat"
    retiredParalelAlias = "par" & "allel"
    retiredMagicAlias = "sihirli" & "metot"
    If identCanonical = retiredThreadAlias Or identCanonical = retiredParalelAlias Or identCanonical = retiredMagicAlias Then
        LexerAddDiagnostic st, "LEX_FORBIDDEN_KEYWORD", "forbidden keyword form: " & s, ln, cn
        PushTokRaw st, "UNKNOWN", s, identCanonical, ln, cn, st.cursor - Len(s)
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If ShouldTreatAsKeyword(st, identCanonical) Then
        PushTokRaw st, "KEYWORD", s, CanonicalKeyword(identCanonical), ln, cn, st.cursor - Len(s)
    Else
        PushTokRaw st, "IDENT", s, identCanonical, ln, cn, st.cursor - Len(s)
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub SkipComment(ByRef st As LexerState)
    Dim ch As String
    Do While Not AtEnd(st)
        ch = PeekCh(st)
        If ch = Chr(10) Then Exit Do
        AdvanceCh st, ch
    Loop
End Sub

Private Sub ReadOperatorOrPunct(ByRef st As LexerState)
    Dim ln As Integer, cn As Integer

Private Function KeywordRequiresIdentifierAfter(ByRef kwText As String) As Integer
    Dim k As String = UCase(Trim(kwText))
    Select Case k
    Case "DIM", "REDIM", "CONST", "FUNCTION", "SUB", "TYPE", "STRUCT", "UNION", "CLASS", "INTERFACE", "ENUM", "NAMESPACE", "MODULE", "ALIAS", "USING", "INCLUDE", "PUBLIC", "PRIVATE", "PROTECTED", "FRIEND", "STATIC", "ABSTRACT", "FINAL", "SEALED", "PROPERTY", "METHOD", "OPERATOR"
        Return 1
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

Private Function ShouldTreatAsKeyword(ByRef st As LexerState, ByRef identCanonical As String) As Integer
    If KeywordRegistryLookup(identCanonical) = 0 Then Return 0

    If st.tokens.count > 0 Then
        Dim prev As Token
        prev = st.tokens.items(st.tokens.count - 1)

        ' Dot member access allows keyword-like names as identifiers (obj.then, ns.print).
        If prev.kind = "OP" And prev.lexeme = "." Then Return 0

        ' Declaration contexts expect a new user identifier.
        ' Do NOT place AS/BYVAL/BYREF/DECLARE here: signature/type tokens must stay keywords.
        If prev.kind = "KEYWORD" Then
            Dim prevKw As String
            prevKw = UCase(Trim(prev.lexeme))
            Select Case prevKw
            Case "AS", "BYVAL", "BYREF", "DECLARE"
                Return 1
            End Select
            If KeywordRequiresIdentifierAfter(prev.lexeme) <> 0 Then Return 0
        End If

        ' Comma after a declaration list keeps identifier context for DIM a, b AS I32.
        If prev.kind = "OP" And prev.lexeme = "," Then
            Dim i As Integer
            For i = st.tokens.count - 2 To 0 Step -1
                If st.tokens.items(i).kind = "EOL" Then Exit For
                If st.tokens.items(i).kind = "KEYWORD" Then
                    If KeywordRequiresIdentifierAfter(st.tokens.items(i).lexeme) <> 0 Then Return 0
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next i
        End If
    End If

    Return 1
End Function

Private Sub ReadStringLiteral(ByRef st As LexerState)
    Dim ln As Integer, cn As Integer
    ln = st.lineNo
    cn = st.colNo

    Dim ch As String, s As String
    AdvanceCh st, ch

    Do While Not AtEnd(st)
        ch = PeekCh(st)
        If ch = Chr(10) Then
            LexerAddDiagnostic st, "LEX_UNTERMINATED_STRING", "unterminated string literal", ln, cn
            PushTok st, "UNKNOWN", s, ln, cn
            Exit Sub
        End If

        If ch = Chr(34) Then
            If PeekChEx(st, 1) = Chr(34) Then
                AdvanceCh st, ch
                AdvanceCh st, ch
                s &= Chr(34)
            Else
                AdvanceCh st, ch
                PushTok st, "STRING", s, ln, cn
                Exit Sub
            End If
        Else
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            s &= ch
        End If
    Loop

    LexerAddDiagnostic st, "LEX_UNTERMINATED_STRING", "unterminated string literal", ln, cn
    PushTok st, "UNKNOWN", s, ln, cn
End Sub

Private Function AtEnd(ByRef st As LexerState) As Integer
    Return st.cursor > Len(st.sourceText)
End Function

Private Function PeekChEx(ByRef st As LexerState, ByVal look As Integer) As String
    Dim p As Integer
    p = st.cursor + look
    If p < 1 Or p > Len(st.sourceText) Then Return ""
    Return Mid(st.sourceText, p, 1)
End Function

Private Function PeekCh(ByRef st As LexerState) As String
    Return PeekChEx(st, 0)
End Function

Declare Sub AdvanceCh(ByRef st As LexerState, ByRef outCh As String)

Private Function TryConsumeLineContinuation(ByRef st As LexerState) As Integer
    If PeekCh(st) <> "_" Then Return 0

    Dim p As Integer
    p = st.cursor + 1

    Do While p <= Len(st.sourceText)
        Dim ch As String
        ch = Mid(st.sourceText, p, 1)
        If IsHorizontalWs(ch) = 0 Then Exit Do
        p += 1
    Loop

    If p <= Len(st.sourceText) Then
        Dim ch As String
        ch = Mid(st.sourceText, p, 1)

        If ch = "'" Then
            Do While p <= Len(st.sourceText)
                ch = Mid(st.sourceText, p, 1)
                If ch = Chr(10) Then Exit Do
                p += 1
            Loop
        End If
    End If

    If p > Len(st.sourceText) Then Return 0
    If Mid(st.sourceText, p, 1) <> Chr(10) Then Return 0

    Dim tmp As String
    Do While st.cursor <= p
        AdvanceCh st, tmp
    Loop

    Return 1
End Function

Private Sub AdvanceCh(ByRef st As LexerState, ByRef outCh As String)
    outCh = PeekCh(st)
    If outCh = "" Then Exit Sub

    st.cursor += 1
    If outCh = Chr(10) Then
        st.lineNo += 1
        st.colNo = 1
    Else
        st.colNo += 1
    End If
End Sub
