Private Sub ReadNumber(ByRef st As LexerState)
    Dim ln As Integer, cn As Integer
    ln = st.lineNo
    cn = st.colNo

    Dim s As String, ch As String
    Dim seenDot As Integer
    Dim seenExp As Integer
    Dim baseText As String
    Dim suffixText As String
    baseText = "DEC"

    If PeekCh(st) = "&" And (UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "H" Or UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "O") Then
        baseText = IIf(UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "H", "HEX", "OCT")
        AdvanceCh st, ch: s &= ch
        AdvanceCh st, ch: s &= ch
        Do While Not AtEnd(st)
            ch = PeekCh(st)
            If (baseText = "HEX" And IsHexDigit(ch) <> 0) Or (baseText = "OCT" And IsOctDigit(ch) <> 0) Then
                AdvanceCh st, ch
                s &= ch
            Else
                Exit Do
            End If
        Loop
        If Len(s) <= 2 Then LexerAddDiagnostic st, "LEX_INVALID_NUMBER", "numeric literal requires digits", ln, cn
        Do While IsAlpha(PeekCh(st)) <> 0 Or IsDigit(PeekCh(st)) <> 0 Or PeekCh(st) = "_"
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            suffixText &= ch
            s &= ch
        Loop
        PushNumberTokRaw st, s, s, ln, cn, st.cursor - Len(s), baseText, suffixText
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If PeekCh(st) = "%" And UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "B" Then
        baseText = "BIN"
        AdvanceCh st, ch: s &= ch
        AdvanceCh st, ch: s &= ch
        Do While Not AtEnd(st)
            ch = PeekCh(st)
            If IsBinDigit(ch) <> 0 Then
                AdvanceCh st, ch
                s &= ch
            Else
                Exit Do
            End If
        Loop
        If Len(s) <= 2 Then LexerAddDiagnostic st, "LEX_INVALID_NUMBER", "binary literal requires digits", ln, cn
        Do While IsAlpha(PeekCh(st)) <> 0 Or IsDigit(PeekCh(st)) <> 0 Or PeekCh(st) = "_"
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            suffixText &= ch
            s &= ch
        Loop
        PushNumberTokRaw st, s, s, ln, cn, st.cursor - Len(s), baseText, suffixText
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If PeekCh(st) = "0" And (UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "X" Or UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "B" Or UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "O") Then
        Select Case UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1))
        Case "X": baseText = "HEX"
        Case "B": baseText = "BIN"
        Case "O": baseText = "OCT"
        End Select
        AdvanceCh st, ch: s &= ch
        AdvanceCh st, ch: s &= ch
        Do While Not AtEnd(st)
            ch = PeekCh(st)
            If (baseText = "HEX" And IsHexDigit(ch) <> 0) Or (baseText = "BIN" And IsBinDigit(ch) <> 0) Or (baseText = "OCT" And IsOctDigit(ch) <> 0) Then
                AdvanceCh st, ch
                s &= ch
            Else
                Exit Do
            End If
        Loop
        If Len(s) <= 2 Then LexerAddDiagnostic st, "LEX_INVALID_NUMBER", "numeric literal requires digits", ln, cn
        Do While IsAlpha(PeekCh(st)) <> 0 Or IsDigit(PeekCh(st)) <> 0 Or PeekCh(st) = "_"
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            suffixText &= ch
            s &= ch
        Loop
        PushNumberTokRaw st, s, s, ln, cn, st.cursor - Len(s), baseText, suffixText
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Do While Not AtEnd(st)
        ch = PeekCh(st)
        If IsDigit(ch) Then
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            s &= ch
        ElseIf ch = "." And seenDot = 0 And IsDigit(PeekChEx(st, 1)) Then
            seenDot = 1
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            s &= ch
        ElseIf (ch = "e" Or ch = "E") And seenExp = 0 And Len(s) > 0 Then
            Dim e1 As String
            Dim e2 As String
            e1 = PeekChEx(st, 1)
            e2 = PeekChEx(st, 2)

            If IsDigit(e1) = 0 And ((e1 <> "+" And e1 <> "-") Or IsDigit(e2) = 0) Then
                Exit Do
            End If

            seenExp = 1
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            s &= ch

            If PeekCh(st) = "+" Or PeekCh(st) = "-" Then
                AdvanceCh st, ch
                s &= ch
            End If
        Else
            Exit Do
        End If
    Loop

    Do While IsAlpha(PeekCh(st)) <> 0 Or IsDigit(PeekCh(st)) <> 0 Or PeekCh(st) = "_"
        AdvanceCh st, ch
        suffixText &= ch
        s &= ch
    Loop

    PushNumberTokRaw st, s, s, ln, cn, st.cursor - Len(s), baseText, suffixText
End Sub

Private Function LexerAtRemCommentStartFix14(ByRef st As LexerState) As Integer
    ' FIX14_REM_COMMENT_20260611:
    ' BASIC REM satir yorumudur. Daha once lexer yalniz tek tirnak yorumunu
    ' atliyordu; "REM PACKAGE: ..." satirlari tokenlere bolunup parser
    ' hatasina dusuyordu. REM sadece satir/statement basinda ve arkasindan
    ' bosluk/EOL gelirse yorum kabul edilir. Boylece degisken adi "remote"
    ' veya "remarkValue" yanlislikla yorum olmaz.
    If UCase(PeekCh(st)) <> "R" Then Return 0
    If UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) <> "E" Then Return 0
    If UCase(PeekChEx(st, 2)) <> "M" Then Return 0

    Dim afterRem As String
    afterRem = PeekChEx(st, 3)
    If afterRem <> "" And afterRem <> " " And afterRem <> Chr(9) And afterRem <> Chr(10) And afterRem <> Chr(13) Then Return 0

    Dim p As Integer
    p = st.cursor - 1
    Do While p >= 1
        Dim prevCh As String
        prevCh = Mid(st.sourceText, p, 1)
        If prevCh = Chr(10) Or prevCh = Chr(13) Then Return 1
        If prevCh = ":" Then Return 1
        If prevCh <> " " And prevCh <> Chr(9) Then Return 0
        p -= 1
    Loop

    Return 1
End Function

Private Function LexerAtRemCommentStartFix14(ByRef st As LexerState) As Integer
    ' FIX14_REM_COMMENT_20260611:
    ' BASIC REM satir yorumudur. Daha once lexer yalniz tek tirnak yorumunu
    ' atliyordu; "REM PACKAGE: ..." satirlari tokenlere bolunup parser
    ' hatasina dusuyordu. REM sadece satir/statement basinda ve arkasindan
    ' bosluk/EOL gelirse yorum kabul edilir. Boylece degisken adi "remote"
    ' veya "remarkValue" yanlislikla yorum olmaz.
    If UCase(PeekCh(st)) <> "R" Then Return 0
    If UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) <> "E" Then Return 0
    If UCase(PeekChEx(st, 2)) <> "M" Then Return 0

    Dim afterRem As String
    afterRem = PeekChEx(st, 3)
    If afterRem <> "" And afterRem <> " " And afterRem <> Chr(9) And afterRem <> Chr(10) And afterRem <> Chr(13) Then Return 0

    Dim p As Integer
    p = st.cursor - 1
    Do While p >= 1
        Dim prevCh As String
        prevCh = Mid(st.sourceText, p, 1)
        If prevCh = Chr(10) Or prevCh = Chr(13) Then Return 1
        If prevCh = ":" Then Return 1
        If prevCh <> " " And prevCh <> Chr(9) Then Return 0
        p -= 1
    Loop

    Return 1
End Function

Private Sub LexSource(ByRef st As LexerState)
    Dim ch As String
    Do While Not AtEnd(st)
        ch = PeekCh(st)

        If ch = Chr(13) Then
            If PeekChEx(st, 1) = Chr(10) Then
                st.cursor += 1
            Else
                AdvanceCh st, ch
            End If
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = "_" Then
            If TryConsumeLineContinuation(st) <> 0 Then
                Continue Do
            End If
        End If

        If ch = Chr(10) Then
            PushTok st, "EOL", "", st.lineNo, st.colNo
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = " " Or ch = Chr(9) Then
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = "'" Then
            SkipComment st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If LexerAtRemCommentStartFix14(st) <> 0 Then
            SkipComment st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = Chr(34) Then
            ReadStringLiteral st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If IsDigit(ch) Or (ch = "&" And (UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "H" Or UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "O")) Or (ch = "%" And UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "B") Then
            ReadNumber st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If IsIdentStart(ch) Then
            ReadIdentifier st
            Continue Do
        End If

        ReadOperatorOrPunct st
    Loop

    PushTok st, "EOF", "", st.lineNo, st.colNo
End Sub

Sub LexerInitFromPreprocessed(ByRef st As LexerState, ByRef src As String, ByVal sourcePath As String = "")
    st.sourceFile = sourcePath
    st.sourceText = src
    st.preprocessFailed = 0

Private Function LexerAtRemCommentStartFix14(ByRef st As LexerState) As Integer
    ' FIX14_REM_COMMENT_20260611:
    ' BASIC REM satir yorumudur. Daha once lexer yalniz tek tirnak yorumunu
    ' atliyordu; "REM PACKAGE: ..." satirlari tokenlere bolunup parser
    ' hatasina dusuyordu. REM sadece satir/statement basinda ve arkasindan
    ' bosluk/EOL gelirse yorum kabul edilir. Boylece degisken adi "remote"
    ' veya "remarkValue" yanlislikla yorum olmaz.
    If UCase(PeekCh(st)) <> "R" Then Return 0
    If UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) <> "E" Then Return 0
    If UCase(PeekChEx(st, 2)) <> "M" Then Return 0

    Dim afterRem As String
    afterRem = PeekChEx(st, 3)
    If afterRem <> "" And afterRem <> " " And afterRem <> Chr(9) And afterRem <> Chr(10) And afterRem <> Chr(13) Then Return 0

    Dim p As Integer
    p = st.cursor - 1
    Do While p >= 1
        Dim prevCh As String
        prevCh = Mid(st.sourceText, p, 1)
        If prevCh = Chr(10) Or prevCh = Chr(13) Then Return 1
        If prevCh = ":" Then Return 1
        If prevCh <> " " And prevCh <> Chr(9) Then Return 0
        p -= 1
    Loop

    Return 1
End Function

Private Sub LexSource(ByRef st As LexerState)
    Dim ch As String
    Do While Not AtEnd(st)
        ch = PeekCh(st)

        If ch = Chr(13) Then
            If PeekChEx(st, 1) = Chr(10) Then
                st.cursor += 1
            Else
                AdvanceCh st, ch
            End If
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = "_" Then
            If TryConsumeLineContinuation(st) <> 0 Then
                Continue Do
            End If
        End If

        If ch = Chr(10) Then
            PushTok st, "EOL", "", st.lineNo, st.colNo
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = " " Or ch = Chr(9) Then
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = "'" Then
            SkipComment st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If LexerAtRemCommentStartFix14(st) <> 0 Then
            SkipComment st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = Chr(34) Then
            ReadStringLiteral st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If IsDigit(ch) Or (ch = "&" And (UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "H" Or UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "O")) Or (ch = "%" And UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "B") Then
            ReadNumber st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If IsIdentStart(ch) Then
            ReadIdentifier st
            Continue Do
        End If

        ReadOperatorOrPunct st
    Loop

    PushTok st, "EOF", "", st.lineNo, st.colNo
End Sub

Private Function ShouldTreatAsKeyword(ByRef st As LexerState, ByRef identCanonical As String) As Integer
    If KeywordRegistryLookup(identCanonical) = 0 Then Return 0

    If st.tokens.count > 0 Then
        Dim prev As Token
        prev = st.tokens.items(st.tokens.count - 1)

        ' Dot member access allows keyword-like names as identifiers (obj.then, ns.print).
        If prev.kind = "OP" And prev.lexeme = "." Then Return 0

        ' Declaration contexts expect a new user identifier.
        ' Do NOT place AS/BYVAL/BYREF/DECLARE here: signature/type tokens must stay keywords.
        If prev.kind = "KEYWORD" Then
            Dim prevKw As String
            prevKw = UCase(Trim(prev.lexeme))
            Select Case prevKw
            Case "AS", "BYVAL", "BYREF", "DECLARE"
                Return 1
            End Select
            If KeywordRequiresIdentifierAfter(prev.lexeme) <> 0 Then Return 0
        End If

        ' Comma after a declaration list keeps identifier context for DIM a, b AS I32.
        If prev.kind = "OP" And prev.lexeme = "," Then
            Dim i As Integer
            For i = st.tokens.count - 2 To 0 Step -1
                If st.tokens.items(i).kind = "EOL" Then Exit For
                If st.tokens.items(i).kind = "KEYWORD" Then
                    If KeywordRequiresIdentifierAfter(st.tokens.items(i).lexeme) <> 0 Then Return 0
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next i
        End If
    End If

    Return 1
End Function

Private Function CanonicalIdentifier(ByVal word As String) As String
    Return LCase(Trim(word))
End Function

Private Function CanonicalKeyword(ByVal word As String) As String
    Return UCase(CanonicalIdentifier(word))
End Function

Private Function IsKeyword(ByVal word As String) As Integer
    Dim k As String
    k = CanonicalIdentifier(word)

    Select Case k
    Case "if", "then", "else", "elseif", "end", "select", "case", "is"
        Return 1
    Case "try", "catch", "finally", "throw", "assert"

    Case "event", "thread", "paralel", "pipe", "slot", "on", "off", "trigger"

Dim Shared gDiagRemScanIters As LongInt
Dim Shared gDiagRemScanCalls As LongInt
Dim Shared gDiagRemScanMax As Integer

Private Function LexerAtRemCommentStartFix14(ByRef st As LexerState) As Integer
    ' FIX14_REM_COMMENT_20260611:
    ' BASIC REM satir yorumudur. Daha once lexer yalniz tek tirnak yorumunu
    ' atliyordu; "REM PACKAGE: ..." satirlari tokenlere bolunup parser
    ' hatasina dusuyordu. REM sadece satir/statement basinda ve arkasindan
    ' bosluk/EOL gelirse yorum kabul edilir. Boylece degisken adi "remote"
    ' veya "remarkValue" yanlislikla yorum olmaz.
    If UCase(PeekCh(st)) <> "R" Then Return 0
    If UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) <> "E" Then Return 0
    If UCase(PeekChEx(st, 2)) <> "M" Then Return 0

    Dim afterRem As String
    afterRem = PeekChEx(st, 3)
    If afterRem <> "" And afterRem <> " " And afterRem <> Chr(9) And afterRem <> Chr(10) And afterRem <> Chr(13) Then Return 0

    Dim p As Integer
    Dim diagIters As Integer
    diagIters = 0
    p = st.cursor - 1
    Do While p >= 1
        diagIters += 1
        Dim prevCh As String
        prevCh = Mid(st.sourceText, p, 1)
        If prevCh = Chr(10) Or prevCh = Chr(13) Then
            gDiagRemScanIters += diagIters
            gDiagRemScanCalls += 1
            If diagIters > gDiagRemScanMax Then gDiagRemScanMax = diagIters
            Return 1
        End If
        If prevCh = ":" Then
            gDiagRemScanIters += diagIters
            gDiagRemScanCalls += 1
            If diagIters > gDiagRemScanMax Then gDiagRemScanMax = diagIters
            Return 1
        End If
        If prevCh <> " " And prevCh <> Chr(9) Then
            gDiagRemScanIters += diagIters
            gDiagRemScanCalls += 1
            If diagIters > gDiagRemScanMax Then gDiagRemScanMax = diagIters
            Return 0
        End If
        p -= 1
    Loop

    gDiagRemScanIters += diagIters
    gDiagRemScanCalls += 1
    If diagIters > gDiagRemScanMax Then gDiagRemScanMax = diagIters
    Return 1
End Function

Private Sub LexSource(ByRef st As LexerState)
    Dim ch As String
    Do While Not AtEnd(st)
        ch = PeekCh(st)

        If ch = Chr(13) Then
            If PeekChEx(st, 1) = Chr(10) Then
                st.cursor += 1
            Else
                AdvanceCh st, ch
            End If
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = "_" Then
            If TryConsumeLineContinuation(st) <> 0 Then
                Continue Do
            End If
        End If

        If ch = Chr(10) Then
            PushTok st, "EOL", "", st.lineNo, st.colNo
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = " " Or ch = Chr(9) Then
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = "'" Then
            SkipComment st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If LexerAtRemCommentStartFix14(st) <> 0 Then
            SkipComment st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = Chr(34) Then
            ReadStringLiteral st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If IsDigit(ch) Or (ch = "&" And (UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "H" Or UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "O")) Or (ch = "%" And UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "B") Then
            ReadNumber st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If IsIdentStart(ch) Then
            ReadIdentifier st
            Continue Do
        End If

        ReadOperatorOrPunct st
    Loop

    PushTok st, "EOF", "", st.lineNo, st.colNo
End Sub

Sub LexerInitFromPreprocessed(ByRef st As LexerState, ByRef src As String, ByVal sourcePath As String = "")
    st.sourceFile = sourcePath
    st.sourceText = src
    st.preprocessFailed = 0
    st.preprocessError = ""
    st.cursor = 1
    st.lineNo = 1
    st.colNo = 1
    TokenListInit st.tokens
    LexerDiagnosticListInit st.diagnostics
    LexSource st
End Sub

Sub LexerInit(ByRef st As LexerState, ByRef src As String, ByVal sourcePath As String = "")
    ' Katman ayrimi: LexerInit artik preprocessor calistirmaz.
    ' Ham veya zaten hazir kaynak metni tokenlere ayirir.
    ' Ana yol: PreprocessRun() -> LexerInitFromPreprocessed().
    LexerInitFromPreprocessed st, src, sourcePath
End Sub

Sub LexerInitWithLegacyPreprocess(ByRef st As LexerState, ByRef src As String, ByVal sourcePath As String = "")
    ' Geriye uyumluluk yolu. Yeni kod bu fonksiyonu kullanmamalidir.
    Dim pp As PreprocessResult
    If LexerPreprocessSourceEx(src, sourcePath, pp) = 0 Then
        LexerInitFromPreprocessed st, pp.expandedSource, sourcePath
        st.preprocessFailed = 1
        st.preprocessError = LexerPreprocessGetError()
        If Trim(st.preprocessError) = "" Then st.preprocessError = "preprocess failed"
        LexerAddDiagnostic st, "LEX_PREPROCESS_LEGACY_DEPRECATED", "LexerInitWithLegacyPreprocess deprecated; use PreprocessRun before lexer", 1, 1
        LexerAddDiagnostic st, "LEX_PREPROCESS_FAILED", st.preprocessError, 1, 1
        Exit Sub
    End If

    LexerInitFromPreprocessed st, pp.expandedSource, sourcePath
    LexerAddDiagnostic st, "LEX_PREPROCESS_LEGACY_DEPRECATED", "LexerInitWithLegacyPreprocess deprecated; use PreprocessRun before lexer", 1, 1
End Sub

    Dim macros() As LexerMacro

    Dim stackCond() As Integer

Function ASTMakeIndex(ByRef p As ASTPool, ByVal baseIdx As Integer, ByVal indexIdx As Integer, ByVal lineNo As Integer, ByVal colNo As Integer) As Integer
    Dim n As Integer = ASTNewNode(p, ASTK_INDEX_EXPR, "", "[]", lineNo, colNo)
    ASTAddRoleChild p, n, baseIdx, "BASE"
    ASTAddRoleChild p, n, indexIdx, "INDEX"
    Return n
End Function

Function ASTMakeNew(ByRef p As ASTPool, ByRef className As String, ByVal lineNo As Integer, ByVal colNo As Integer) As Integer
    Return ASTNewNode(p, ASTK_NEW_EXPR, className, "", lineNo, colNo)
End Function

Private Function ASTJsonEscape(ByRef textIn As String) As String
    Dim outText As String = ""
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To Len(textIn)
        Dim ch As String = Mid(textIn, i, 1)
        Select Case Asc(ch)
        Case 8: outText &= "\b"
        Case 9: outText &= "\t"
        Case 10: outText &= "\n"
        Case 13: outText &= "\r"
        Case 34: outText &= "\"""
        Case 92: outText &= "\\"
        Case Else
            If Asc(ch) < 32 Then outText &= "?" Else outText &= ch
        End Select
    Next i
    Return outText
End Function

Private Sub ASTAppendIndent(ByRef textOut As String, ByVal depth As Integer)
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To depth: textOut &= "  ": Next i
End Sub

Private Function ASTContractJsonGroupForFamily(ByVal familyValue As Integer, ByRef kindName As String) As String
    Dim k As String = UCase(Trim(kindName))
    If k = ASTK_PROGRAM Then Return "PROGRAM_STRUCTURE"
    If k = ASTK_BLOCK Then Return "STATEMENT"
    If Instr(k, "CLASS_") = 1 Or Instr(k, "INTERFACE_") = 1 Then Return "OOP"
    If Instr(k, "TYPE_") = 1 Or k = ASTK_TYPE_REF Or k = ASTK_RETURN_TYPE Then Return "TYPE_SYSTEM"
    If k = ASTK_IF_STMT Or k = ASTK_FOR_STMT Or k = ASTK_FOR_EACH_STMT Or k = ASTK_DO_STMT Or k = ASTK_DO_EACH_STMT Or k = ASTK_SELECT_STMT Or k = ASTK_CASE_BLOCK Or k = ASTK_CASE_ELSE Or k = ASTK_ELSEIF_PART Or k = ASTK_ELSE_PART Or k = ASTK_EXIT_STMT Or k = ASTK_RETURN_STMT Or k = ASTK_GOTO_STMT Or k = ASTK_GOSUB_STMT Or k = ASTK_END_STMT Then Return "CONTROL_FLOW"
    If k = ASTK_TRY_STMT Or k = ASTK_TRY_BODY Or k = ASTK_CATCH_PART Or k = ASTK_FINALLY_PART Or k = ASTK_THROW_STMT Or k = ASTK_ASSERT_STMT Then Return "ERROR_HANDLING"
    If k = ASTK_OPEN_STMT Or k = ASTK_CLOSE_STMT Or k = ASTK_GET_STMT Or k = ASTK_PUT_STMT Or k = ASTK_SEEK_STMT Or k = ASTK_INPUT_FILE_STMT Or k = ASTK_INPUTF_STMT Then Return "FILE_IO"
    If Instr(k, "POKE") > 0 Or Instr(k, "MEMCOPY") > 0 Or Instr(k, "MEMFILL") > 0 Or k = ASTK_SETNEWOFFSET_STMT Then Return "MEMORY"
    If k = ASTK_IMPORT_STMT Or k = ASTK_INCLUDE_STMT Or k = ASTK_USING_STMT Or k = ASTK_ALIAS_STMT Or k = ASTK_MODULE_STMT Or k = ASTK_NAMESPACE_STMT Then Return "MODULE_SYSTEM"
    If k = ASTK_INLINE_STMT Then Return "FFI"
    If familyValue = AST_FAMILY_EXPR Then Return "EXPRESSION"
    If familyValue = AST_FAMILY_DECL Or familyValue = AST_FAMILY_PARAM Then Return "DECLARATION"
    If familyValue = AST_FAMILY_STMT Then Return "STATEMENT"
    Return "DIAGNOSTIC"
End Function

Private Function ASTContractJsonTargetSupport(ByRef kindName As String, ByVal familyValue As Integer) As String
    Return UXBAstContractTargetSupportJson(kindName)
End Function

Private Sub ASTAppendNodeJson(ByRef p As ASTPool, ByVal nodeIdx As Integer, ByVal depth As Integer, ByRef textOut As String)
    If nodeIdx < 0 Or nodeIdx >= p.count Then textOut &= "null": Exit Sub
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth: textOut &= "{" & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """index"": " & LTrim(Str(nodeIdx)) & "," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """kind"": """ & ASTJsonEscape(p.nodes(nodeIdx).kind) & """," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """value"": """ & ASTJsonEscape(p.nodes(nodeIdx).value) & """," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """op"": """ & ASTJsonEscape(p.nodes(nodeIdx).op) & """," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """line"": " & LTrim(Str(p.nodes(nodeIdx).lineNo)) & "," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """column"": " & LTrim(Str(p.nodes(nodeIdx).colNo)) & "," & Chr(10)
    Dim parentText As String
    If p.nodes(nodeIdx).parent = AST_NULL Then
        parentText = "null"
    Else
        parentText = LTrim(Str(p.nodes(nodeIdx).parent))
    End If
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """parent"": " & parentText & "," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """family"": " & LTrim(Str(p.nodes(nodeIdx).family)) & "," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """flags"": " & LTrim(Str(p.nodes(nodeIdx).flags)) & "," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """type"": """ & ASTJsonEscape(p.nodes(nodeIdx).typeName) & """," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """symbol"": """ & ASTJsonEscape(p.nodes(nodeIdx).symbolName) & """," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """role"": """ & ASTJsonEscape(p.nodes(nodeIdx).role) & """," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """contract_status"": """ & UXBAstContractFinalDecisionForNode(p.nodes(nodeIdx).kind) & """," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """contract_group"": """ & ASTJsonEscape(ASTContractJsonGroupForFamily(p.nodes(nodeIdx).family, p.nodes(nodeIdx).kind)) & """," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """target_support"": " & ASTContractJsonTargetSupport(p.nodes(nodeIdx).kind, p.nodes(nodeIdx).family) & "," & Chr(10)

    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """left"": "
    If p.nodes(nodeIdx).left = AST_NULL Then textOut &= "null" Else textOut &= Chr(10): ASTAppendNodeJson p, p.nodes(nodeIdx).left, depth + 2, textOut
    textOut &= "," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """right"": "
    If p.nodes(nodeIdx).right = AST_NULL Then textOut &= "null" Else textOut &= Chr(10): ASTAppendNodeJson p, p.nodes(nodeIdx).right, depth + 2, textOut
    textOut &= "," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1: textOut &= """children"": ["
    Dim ch As Integer = p.nodes(nodeIdx).firstChild
    If ch <> AST_NULL Then textOut &= Chr(10)
    Do While ch <> AST_NULL
        ASTAppendNodeJson p, ch, depth + 2, textOut
        ch = p.nodes(ch).nextSibling
        If ch <> AST_NULL Then textOut &= "," & Chr(10)
    Loop
    If p.nodes(nodeIdx).firstChild <> AST_NULL Then textOut &= Chr(10): ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth + 1
    textOut &= "]" & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent textOut, depth: textOut &= "}"
End Sub

Function ASTToJson(ByRef p As ASTPool, ByVal rootIdx As Integer, ByRef jsonOut As String) As Integer
    jsonOut = "{" & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent jsonOut, 1: jsonOut &= """node_count"": " & LTrim(Str(p.count)) & "," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent jsonOut, 1: jsonOut &= """root"": "
    If rootIdx = AST_NULL Then jsonOut &= "null" & Chr(10) Else jsonOut &= Chr(10): ASTAppendNodeJson p, rootIdx, 2, jsonOut: jsonOut &= Chr(10)
    jsonOut &= "}" & Chr(10)
    Return 1
End Function

Function ASTWriteJson(ByRef p As ASTPool, ByVal rootIdx As Integer, ByRef outPath As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim jsonText As String
    If ASTToJson(p, rootIdx, jsonText) = 0 Then errText = "ast: json conversion failed": Return 0
    Dim f As Integer = FreeFile
    Open outPath For Output As #f

' AST JSON serialization used to accumulate directly into one big String via
' repeated "&=". Each append reallocates and copies the whole buffer, so for a
' tree with thousands of nodes (dozens of appends per node) that was a genuine
' O(n^2) cost - multi-second AST JSON writes on any moderately large program,
' since this report is written on every run by default. ASTJsonBuf collects
' fragments into a geometrically-grown array and joins them once at the end,
' turning the accumulation into O(n) amortized. External callers (ASTToJson's
' ByRef jsonOut As String contract) are unaffected.
Type ASTJsonBuf
    chunks(Any) As String
    count As Integer
    capacity As Integer
End Type

Private Sub ASTJsonBufInit(ByRef b As ASTJsonBuf)
    b.capacity = 256
    ReDim b.chunks(b.capacity - 1)
    b.count = 0
End Sub

Private Sub ASTJsonBufAppend(ByRef b As ASTJsonBuf, ByRef s As String)
    If b.count >= b.capacity Then
        Dim newCap As Integer = b.capacity * 2
        ReDim Preserve b.chunks(newCap - 1)
        b.capacity = newCap
    End If
    b.chunks(b.count) = s
    b.count += 1
End Sub

Private Function ASTJsonBufToString(ByRef b As ASTJsonBuf) As String
    If b.count <= 0 Then Return ""
    ReDim Preserve b.chunks(b.count - 1)
    Return Join(b.chunks(), "")
End Function

Private Sub ASTAppendIndent(ByRef buf As ASTJsonBuf, ByVal depth As Integer)
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To depth: ASTJsonBufAppend buf, "  ": Next i
End Sub

Function ASTToJson(ByRef p As ASTPool, ByVal rootIdx As Integer, ByRef jsonOut As String) As Integer
    Dim buf As ASTJsonBuf
    ASTJsonBufInit buf
    ASTJsonBufAppend buf, "{" & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent buf, 1: ASTJsonBufAppend buf, """node_count"": " & LTrim(Str(p.count)) & "," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent buf, 1: ASTJsonBufAppend buf, """root"": "
    If rootIdx = AST_NULL Then
        ASTJsonBufAppend buf, "null" & Chr(10)
    Else
        ASTJsonBufAppend buf, Chr(10)
        ASTAppendNodeJson p, rootIdx, 2, buf
        ASTJsonBufAppend buf, Chr(10)
    End If
    ASTJsonBufAppend buf, "}" & Chr(10)
    jsonOut = ASTJsonBufToString(buf)
    Return 1
End Function

    ASTAppendIndent buf, depth + 1: ASTJsonBufAppend buf, """role"": """ & ASTJsonEscape(p.nodes(nodeIdx).role) & """," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent buf, depth + 1: ASTJsonBufAppend buf, """contract_status"": """ & UXBAstContractFinalDecisionForNode(p.nodes(nodeIdx).kind) & """," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent buf, depth + 1: ASTJsonBufAppend buf, """contract_group"": """ & ASTJsonEscape(ASTContractJsonGroupForFamily(p.nodes(nodeIdx).family, p.nodes(nodeIdx).kind)) & """," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent buf, depth + 1: ASTJsonBufAppend buf, """target_support"": " & ASTContractJsonTargetSupport(p.nodes(nodeIdx).kind, p.nodes(nodeIdx).family) & "," & Chr(10)

        ASTAppendNodeJson p, p.nodes(nodeIdx).left, depth + 2, buf
    End If
    ASTJsonBufAppend buf, "," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent buf, depth + 1: ASTJsonBufAppend buf, """right"": "
    If p.nodes(nodeIdx).right = AST_NULL Then
        ASTJsonBufAppend buf, "null"
    Else
        ASTJsonBufAppend buf, Chr(10)
        ASTAppendNodeJson p, p.nodes(nodeIdx).right, depth + 2, buf
    End If
    ASTJsonBufAppend buf, "," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent buf, depth + 1: ASTJsonBufAppend buf, """children"": ["
    Dim ch As Integer = p.nodes(nodeIdx).firstChild
    If ch <> AST_NULL Then ASTJsonBufAppend buf, Chr(10)

        If ch <> AST_NULL Then ASTJsonBufAppend buf, "," & Chr(10)
    Loop
    If p.nodes(nodeIdx).firstChild <> AST_NULL Then
        ASTJsonBufAppend buf, Chr(10)
        ASTAppendIndent buf, depth + 1
    End If
    ASTJsonBufAppend buf, "]" & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent buf, depth: ASTJsonBufAppend buf, "}"
End Sub

Function ASTToJson(ByRef p As ASTPool, ByVal rootIdx As Integer, ByRef jsonOut As String) As Integer
    Dim buf As ASTJsonBuf
    ASTJsonBufInit buf
    ASTJsonBufAppend buf, "{" & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent buf, 1: ASTJsonBufAppend buf, """node_count"": " & LTrim(Str(p.count)) & "," & Chr(10)
    ASTAppendIndent buf, 1: ASTJsonBufAppend buf, """root"": "
    If rootIdx = AST_NULL Then
        ASTJsonBufAppend buf, "null" & Chr(10)
    Else
        ASTJsonBufAppend buf, Chr(10)
        ASTAppendNodeJson p, rootIdx, 2, buf
        ASTJsonBufAppend buf, Chr(10)
    End If
    ASTJsonBufAppend buf, "}" & Chr(10)
    jsonOut = ASTJsonBufToString(buf)
    Return 1
End Function

    If b.count <= 0 Then Return ""

    totalLen = 0

    For i = 0 To b.count - 1
        totalLen += Len(b.chunks(i))
    Next i

    Next i

Sub UXBSemanticGateResultInit(ByRef r As UXBSemanticGateResult)
    r.ok = 0
    r.semanticOk = 0
    r.hirSemanticOk = 0
    r.hirBridgeOk = 0

    r.layoutTableOk = 0
    r.layoutIntrinsicOk = 0
    r.errorText = ""
End Sub

Private Sub UXBSemanticGatePlanAdd(ByRef plan As UXBActiveBindPlan, ByRef gateText As String, ByRef fnText As String, ByVal okValue As Integer, ByRef noteText As String)
    Dim st As String
    If okValue <> 0 Then st = "PASS" Else st = "FAIL"
    UXBActiveBindPlanAdd plan, "SEMANTIC", gateText, fnText, st, noteText
End Sub

Function UXBSemanticRunAllGates(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef r As UXBSemanticGateResult, ByRef plan As UXBActiveBindPlan, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    UXBSemanticGateResultInit r
    errText = ""

    UXBActiveBindPlanAdd plan, "SEMANTIC", "ast_contract_step2_semantic_bridge", "SemStep2ContractStatus/SemStep2*Contract", "BOUND", "AST node layer status is available to semantic gates."
    UXBActiveBindPlanAdd plan, "SEMANTIC", "layout_ast_contract_bridge", "LayoutStep2Contract", "BOUND", "Layout bridge is present; concrete layout table build runs below."
    UXBActiveBindPlanAdd plan, "SEMANTIC", "library_module_contract", "UXBLibraryModuleStatusName", "BOUND", "Library module vocabulary is loaded for import/library policy decisions."

    UXBActiveBindPlanAdd plan, "SEMANTIC", "type_binding_ast_contract_bridge", "TypeBindingStep2*Contract", "BOUND", "Type binding AST contract bridge is loaded."

    Dim semanticErr As String
    If SemanticAnalyze(ps, semanticErr) = 0 Then
        r.semanticOk = 0
        r.errorText = semanticErr
        UXBSemanticGatePlanAdd plan, "semantic_pass", "SemanticAnalyze", 0, semanticErr
        errText = semanticErr
        Return 0
    End If
    r.semanticOk = 1
    UXBSemanticGatePlanAdd plan, "semantic_pass", "SemanticAnalyze", 1, "Core semantic analysis completed."

    Dim hirSemanticErr As String
    If HIRSemanticAnalyze(ps, hirSemanticErr) = 0 Then
        r.hirSemanticOk = 0
        r.errorText = hirSemanticErr
        UXBSemanticGatePlanAdd plan, "hir_semantic_pass", "HIRSemanticAnalyze", 0, hirSemanticErr
        errText = hirSemanticErr
        Return 0
    End If
    r.hirSemanticOk = 1
    UXBSemanticGatePlanAdd plan, "hir_semantic_pass", "HIRSemanticAnalyze", 1, "HIR semantic analysis completed."

    Dim hirErr As String
    If HIRBuildBridgeAfterSemantic(ps, gHIRBridge, hirErr) = 0 Then
        r.hirBridgeOk = 0
        r.errorText = hirErr
        UXBSemanticGatePlanAdd plan, "hir_bridge", "HIRBuildBridgeAfterSemantic", 0, hirErr
        errText = hirErr
        Return 0
    End If
    r.hirBridgeOk = 1
    UXBSemanticGatePlanAdd plan, "hir_bridge", "HIRBuildBridgeAfterSemantic", 1, "AST/HIR scope, symbol and type facts were built."

    Dim mirPrepErr As String
    If HIRPrepareMirLowering(ps, gHIRBridge, mirPrepErr) = 0 Then
        r.mirLoweringReadyOk = 0
        r.errorText = mirPrepErr
        UXBSemanticGatePlanAdd plan, "hir_to_mir_bridge", "HIRPrepareMirLowering", 0, mirPrepErr
        errText = mirPrepErr
        Return 0
    End If
    r.mirLoweringReadyOk = 1
    UXBSemanticGatePlanAdd plan, "hir_to_mir_bridge", "HIRPrepareMirLowering", 1, "HIR facts are ready for MIR lowering."

    If BuildTypeLayoutTable(ps) = 0 Then
        r.layoutTableOk = 0
        r.errorText = "semantic/layout: BuildTypeLayoutTable failed"
        UXBSemanticGatePlanAdd plan, "layout_table", "BuildTypeLayoutTable", 0, r.errorText
        errText = r.errorText
        Return 0
    End If
    TypeBindingRefreshUserLayouts
    r.layoutTableOk = 1
    UXBSemanticGatePlanAdd plan, "layout_table", "BuildTypeLayoutTable", 1, "TYPE/STRUCT/UNION/CLASS layout table was built and type bindings were refreshed."

    If ValidateLayoutIntrinsicSemantics(ps) = 0 Then
        r.layoutIntrinsicOk = 0
        r.errorText = "semantic/layout: intrinsic validation failed"
        UXBSemanticGatePlanAdd plan, "layout_intrinsic", "ValidateLayoutIntrinsicSemantics", 0, r.errorText
        errText = r.errorText
        Return 0
    End If
    r.layoutIntrinsicOk = 1

Function SemanticAnalyze(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    errText = ""

    If ps.rootNode = -1 Or ps.ast.count = 0 Then
        errText = "semantic: bos AST"
        Return 0
    End If

    If SemValidateTypeRefs(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateClassMixinDecoratorContracts(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateCallNodes(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateImportNodes(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateInputNodes(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateSlotLaneNodes(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateIfSelectNodes(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateErrorFlowNodes(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateRoutineNodes(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateConstNodes(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateNewExprNodes(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateDimClassInitializers(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateClassAssignments(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateDeleteNodes(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemFoldConstants(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateOverloadResolution(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateReachability(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateThisMeUsage(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateStaticMemberReceiverUsage(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateClassModifierContracts(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateClassPropertyContracts(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateClassOperatorContracts(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateClassMagicMethodContracts(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateClassOverrideContracts(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemValidateInterfaceContracts(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If SemAssignVtableSlots(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0

    Dim step3Err As String
    If SemStep3SemanticTypeLayoutGate(ps, step3Err) = 0 Then
        errText = "semantic-step3: " & step3Err
        Return 0
    End If

    Return 1
End Function

Function SemStep3SemanticTypeLayoutGate(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    errText = ""
    TypeBindingInit
    UXBStep3SymbolReset
    UXBStep3ScopeReset
    Dim ctx As UXBSemanticContext
    UXBSemanticContextInit(ctx, "X64")
    If Step3ValidateContractCoverage(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3RegisterDeclaredTypes(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateEnums(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3BindDeclarations(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateExpressions(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateStatements(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateAssignments(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateCallsAndReturns(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateFFI(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateTypeLeak(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateLayoutCoverage(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateTargetCoverage(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0

    Dim step5 As UXBSemanticStep5Result
    Dim step5Gate As UXBSemanticStep5GateResult
    Dim step5Err As String

    If UXBSemanticStep5Run(ps, step5, step5Err) = 0 Then
        errText = step5Err
        Return 0
    End If

    If UXBSemanticStep5GateCheck(step5, step5Gate) = 0 Then
        errText = step5Gate.errorsText
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim writeErr As String
    UXBSemanticStep5WriteGateJson step5, step5Gate, "build/manual/logs/adim5_gate.json", writeErr
    UXBSemanticStep5WriteGateMarkdown step5, step5Gate, "build/manual/logs/adim5_gate.md", writeErr
    UXBSemanticStep5WriteTypeCsv step5, "build/manual/logs/adim5_type_table.csv", writeErr
    UXBSemanticStep5WriteLayoutCsv step5, "build/manual/logs/adim5_layout_report.csv", writeErr
    ' semantic_enums.json artik UXBOutputContractAfterSemantic tarafindan build/<run_id>/json/semantic/enums.json altina yazilir.

    Return 1
End Function
#endif

Function UXBSemanticStep5GateCheck(ByRef r As UXBSemanticStep5Result, ByRef g As UXBSemanticStep5GateResult) As Integer
    UXBSemanticStep5GateInit g
    g.checkedCount = r.typeFactCount

    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To r.typeTable.factCount - 1
        If r.typeTable.facts(i).typeStatus = "MISSING_TYPE" Then
            g.missingTypeCount += 1
            g.errorsText &= "missing type at ast=" & LTrim(Str(r.typeTable.facts(i).astNode)) & " kind=" & r.typeTable.facts(i).kind & Chr(10)
        End If
    Next i

    If r.hirFactCount <= 0 Then
        g.missingHIRFactCount = 1
        g.errorsText &= "HIR fact table bos" & Chr(10)
    End If

    If r.layoutFactCount < 0 Then
        g.missingLayoutCount = 1
        g.errorsText &= "layout snapshot gecersiz" & Chr(10)
    End If

    If g.missingTypeCount = 0 And g.missingHIRFactCount = 0 And g.missingLayoutCount = 0 Then
        g.ok = 1
        Return 1
    End If
    Return 0
End Function

#endif

Private Function UXBStep5IsNameOnlyIdentContext(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal nodeIdx As Integer) As Integer
    Dim pk As String
    pk = UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, nodeIdx)
    Select Case pk
    Case "FUNCTION_STMT", "SUB_STMT", "DECLARE_FUNCTION_STMT", "DECLARE_SUB_STMT", "PARAM_DECL", "TYPE_REF", "RETURN_TYPE", "MODE_REF", "ALIAS_TARGET", "USING_ITEM", "IMPLEMENTS_REF", "EXTENDS_REF"
        Return 1
    End Select

    ' Is this node the right-hand operand of a "|>" BINARY node? That is always
    ' its structural parent, so read it directly via the AST's own parent link
    ' instead of rescanning every node in the program to find it - this used to
    ' be a full-tree scan called once per IDENT/IDENTIFIER/KEYWORD_REF node
    ' (i.e. O(ast size) work per identifier, O(n^2) overall for the whole pass).
    If nodeIdx >= 0 And nodeIdx < ps.ast.count Then
        Dim parentIdx As Integer
        parentIdx = ps.ast.nodes(nodeIdx).parent
        If parentIdx >= 0 And parentIdx < ps.ast.count Then
            If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(parentIdx).kind)) = "BINARY" And Trim(ps.ast.nodes(parentIdx).op) = "|>" Then
                If ps.ast.nodes(parentIdx).right = nodeIdx Then Return 1
            End If
        End If
    End If
    Return 0
End Function

#ifndef UXB_SYMBOL_TABLE_FBS
#define UXB_SYMBOL_TABLE_FBS

#include once "symbol_kind.fbs"
#include once "symbol_record.fbs"
#include once "symbol_key.fbs"
#include once "scope_table.fbs"
#include once "symbol_index.fbs"

Dim Shared gUXBStep3Symbols(Any) As UXBSymbolRecord
Dim Shared gUXBStep3SymbolCount As Integer
Dim Shared gUXBStep3SymbolCap As Integer

Private Sub UXBStep3SymbolEnsure(ByVal minCount As Integer)
    If gUXBStep3SymbolCap >= minCount Then Exit Sub
    If gUXBStep3SymbolCap < 1 Then gUXBStep3SymbolCap = 128
    Do While gUXBStep3SymbolCap < minCount
        gUXBStep3SymbolCap *= 2
    Loop
    ReDim Preserve gUXBStep3Symbols(gUXBStep3SymbolCap - 1)
End Sub

Sub UXBStep3SymbolReset()
    gUXBStep3SymbolCount = 0
    gUXBStep3SymbolCap = 0
    ReDim gUXBStep3Symbols(0)
    UXBSymHashReset
End Sub

Private Function UXBStep3SymbolFindExactLinear(ByVal nameText As String, ByVal kindText As String, ByVal scopeId As Integer) As Integer
    Dim key As String = UXBSymNormalizeName(nameText)
    Dim kindKey As String = UXBSymNormalizeKind(kindText)
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To gUXBStep3SymbolCount - 1
        If UXBSymNormalizeName(gUXBStep3Symbols(i).name) = key Then
            If kindKey = "" Or UXBSymNormalizeKind(gUXBStep3Symbols(i).kind) = kindKey Then
                If gUXBStep3Symbols(i).scopeId = scopeId Then Return i
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    Return -1
End Function

Function UXBStep3SymbolFindExact(ByVal nameText As String, ByVal kindText As String, ByVal scopeId As Integer) As Integer
    Dim idx As Integer
    If Trim(kindText) <> "" Then
        idx = UXBSymHashLookupExact(scopeId, nameText, kindText)
        If idx <> -1 Then Return idx
    End If
    Return UXBStep3SymbolFindExactLinear(nameText, kindText, scopeId)
End Function

Function UXBStep3SymbolFind(ByVal nameText As String, ByVal kindText As String, ByVal scopeId As Integer) As Integer
    Dim cur As Integer = scopeId
    Do While cur >= 0
        Dim idx As Integer = UXBStep3SymbolFindExact(nameText, kindText, cur)
        If idx <> -1 Then Return idx
        If cur <> 0 And UXBScopeIsValid(cur) = 0 Then
            ' Semantic scopes use AST node index + 1 as a stable scope id.
            ' Those ids are intentionally sparse and are not all pushed onto
            ' the runtime scope stack. They still have the global scope as
            ' their lexical parent.
            cur = 0
        Else
            cur = UXBScopeParent(cur)
        End If
    Loop
    Return -1
End Function

Function UXBStep3SymbolAdd(ByVal nameText As String, ByVal kindText As String, ByVal typeText As String, ByVal scopeId As Integer, ByVal astNode As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim key As String = UXBSymNormalizeName(nameText)
    Dim kindKey As String = UXBSymNormalizeKind(kindText)
    If key = "" Then errText = "symbol: empty name": Return -1
    If UXBStep3SymbolFindExact(key, kindKey, scopeId) <> -1 Then errText = "symbol: duplicate " & key: Return -1

    UXBStep3SymbolEnsure(gUXBStep3SymbolCount + 1)
    Dim idx As Integer = gUXBStep3SymbolCount
    gUXBStep3SymbolCount += 1

    gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).name = key
    gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).kind = kindKey
    gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).typeName = UCase(Trim(typeText))
    gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).scopeId = scopeId
    gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).astNode = astNode
    gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).flags = 0

    If kindKey <> "" Then UXBSymHashInsert scopeId, key, kindKey, idx

    errText = ""
    Return idx
End Function

#endif

#ifndef UXB_HIR_BUILDER_FBS
#define UXB_HIR_BUILDER_FBS

#include once "hir_ast_bridge.fbs"
#include once "hir_scope_bridge.fbs"
#include once "hir_symbol_bridge.fbs"
#include once "hir_fact_table.fbs"
#include once "semantic_targets.fbs"

Type HIRBridge
    scopeMap As HIRScopeMap
    facts As HIRFactTable
    ok As Integer
    errorCount As Integer
    warningCount As Integer
    diagnosticText As String
End Type

Dim Shared gHIRBridge As HIRBridge

Private Function HIRNodeDeclaredType(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal nodeIdx As Integer, ByRef typeOut As String) As Integer
    typeOut = ""
    If nodeIdx < 0 Or nodeIdx >= ps.ast.count Then Return 0
    If Trim(ps.ast.nodes(nodeIdx).typeName) <> "" Then
        typeOut = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(nodeIdx).typeName))
        Return 1
    End If
    Dim tNode As Integer = HIRAstFindChildByKind(ps, nodeIdx, "TYPE_REF")
    If tNode <> -1 Then
        typeOut = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(tNode).value))
        Return IIf(typeOut <> "", 1, 0)
    End If
    Return 0
End Function

Private Function HIRAstKindIsCompileTime(ByRef k As String) As Integer
    If Left(k, 5) = "META_" Then Return 1
    If k = "INCLUDE_STMT" Or k = "IMPORT_STMT" Or k = "ALIAS_STMT" Or k = "USING_STMT" Then Return 1
    Return 0
End Function

Private Function HIRAstKindIsRuntime(ByRef k As String) As Integer
    If InStr(k, "_STMT") > 0 Then Return 1
    If InStr(k, "_EXPR") > 0 Then Return 1
    If k = "BINARY" Or k = "UNARY" Or k = "IDENT" Or k = "IDENTIFIER" Or k = "NUMBER" Or k = "STRING" Then Return 1
    Return 0
End Function

Private Function HIRFillOneFact(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef bridge As HIRBridge, ByVal nodeIdx As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim f As HIRAstFact Ptr = HIRFactForNode(bridge.facts, nodeIdx)
    If f = 0 Then Return 1

    Dim ByRef n As ASTNode = ps.ast.nodes(nodeIdx)
    f->astNode = nodeIdx
    f->astKind = UCase(Trim(n.kind))
    f->hirScopeId = bridge.scopeMap.astNodeToOwnerScope(nodeIdx)
    f->storageClass = HIRInferStorageClass(f->astKind)
    HIRFactSetSourceFromAst *f, n

    Dim tn As String
    If HIRNodeDeclaredType(ps, nodeIdx, tn) <> 0 Then
        f->typeName = tn
    ElseIf Trim(n.typeName) <> "" Then
        f->typeName = UCase(Trim(n.typeName))
    Else
        f->typeName = ""
    End If

    Dim sr As HIRSymbolRef
    If HIRFindSymbolForAstNode(ps, bridge.scopeMap, nodeIdx, "", sr) <> 0 Then
        f->symbolIndex = sr.symbolIndex
        f->symbolName = sr.name
        f->symbolKind = sr.kind
        If f->typeName = "" Then f->typeName = sr.typeName
    Else
        f->symbolIndex = -1
        f->symbolName = HIRAstNodeValueOrSymbol(ps, nodeIdx)
        f->symbolKind = ""
    End If

    If HIRAstKindIsCompileTime(f->astKind) <> 0 Then
        f->isCompileTimeNode = 1
        f->isRuntimeNode = 0
        f->isLowerableToMir = 0
    ElseIf HIRAstKindIsRuntime(f->astKind) <> 0 Then
        f->isCompileTimeNode = 0
        f->isRuntimeNode = 1
        f->isLowerableToMir = 1
    End If

    Dim targetErr As String
    If SemStep3TargetDecisionExists(f->astKind, targetErr) <> 0 Then
        f->targetMask = 1
    Else
        f->targetMask = 0
        f->diagnostic = targetErr
    End If

    If f->isLowerableToMir <> 0 And f->targetMask = 0 Then
        f->status = "BLOCKED"
    Else
        f->status = "OK"
    End If

    Return 1
End Function

Function HIRBuildBridgeAfterSemantic(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef bridge As HIRBridge, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    bridge.ok = 0
    bridge.errorCount = 0
    bridge.warningCount = 0
    bridge.diagnosticText = ""
    errText = ""

    If ps.rootNode < 0 Or ps.ast.count <= 0 Then
        errText = "hir_builder: bos AST"
        bridge.diagnosticText = errText
        bridge.errorCount = 1
        Return 0
    End If

    If HIRBuildScopeMap(ps, bridge.scopeMap, errText) = 0 Then
        bridge.diagnosticText = errText
        bridge.errorCount = 1
        Return 0
    End If

    HIRFactTableInit bridge.facts, ps.ast.count
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To ps.ast.count - 1
        If HIRFillOneFact(ps, bridge, i, errText) = 0 Then
            bridge.diagnosticText = errText
            bridge.errorCount += 1
            Return 0
        End If
        If bridge.facts.facts(i).status = "BLOCKED" Then bridge.warningCount += 1
    Next i

    bridge.ok = 1
    Return 1
End Function

#endif

#ifndef UXB_HIR_SYMBOL_BRIDGE_FBS
#define UXB_HIR_SYMBOL_BRIDGE_FBS

#include once "../symbols/symbol_resolver.fbs"
#include once "hir_scope_bridge.fbs"

Type HIRSymbolRef
    found As Integer
    symbolIndex As Integer
    name As String
    kind As String
    typeName As String
    step3ScopeId As Integer
    hirScopeId As Integer
    astNode As Integer
    flags As Integer
End Type

Sub HIRSymbolRefClear(ByRef r As HIRSymbolRef)
    r.found = 0
    r.symbolIndex = -1
    r.name = ""
    r.kind = ""
    r.typeName = ""
    r.step3ScopeId = -1
    r.hirScopeId = -1
    r.astNode = -1
    r.flags = 0
End Sub

Private Function HIRSymbolRefFromStep3Index(ByVal idx As Integer, ByVal hirScopeId As Integer, ByRef r As HIRSymbolRef) As Integer
    If idx < 0 Or idx >= gUXBStep3SymbolCount Then Return 0
    r.found = 1
    r.symbolIndex = idx
    r.name = gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).name
    r.kind = gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).kind
    r.typeName = gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).typeName
    r.step3ScopeId = gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).scopeId
    r.hirScopeId = hirScopeId
    r.astNode = gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).astNode
    r.flags = gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).flags
    Return 1
End Function

Function HIRFindSymbolForAstNode(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef sm As HIRScopeMap, ByVal nodeIdx As Integer, ByRef kindText As String, ByRef outRef As HIRSymbolRef) As Integer
    HIRSymbolRefClear outRef
    If nodeIdx < 0 Or nodeIdx >= ps.ast.count Then Return 0

    Dim nameText As String = HIRAstNodeValueOrSymbol(ps, nodeIdx)
    If Trim(nameText) = "" Then Return 0

    Dim startScope As Integer = sm.astNodeToOwnerScope(nodeIdx)
    Dim rr As UXBSymbolResolveResult
    If Trim(kindText) <> "" Then
        If UXBSymbolResolveLexical(startScope, nameText, kindText, rr) <> 0 Then Return HIRSymbolRefFromStep3Index(rr.symbolIdx, startScope, outRef)
    Else
        If UXBSymbolResolveAnyKindLexical(startScope, nameText, rr) <> 0 Then Return HIRSymbolRefFromStep3Index(rr.symbolIdx, startScope, outRef)
    End If
    Return 0
End Function

#endif

Sub UXBSymbolResolveClear(ByRef r As UXBSymbolResolveResult)
    r.found = 0
    r.symbolIdx = -1
    r.scopeId = -1
    r.name = ""
    r.kind = ""
    r.typeName = ""
    r.diagnostic = ""
End Sub

Private Function UXBSymbolResolveFromIndex(ByVal idx As Integer, ByRef r As UXBSymbolResolveResult) As Integer
    If idx < 0 Or idx >= gUXBStep3SymbolCount Then Return 0
    r.found = 1
    r.symbolIdx = idx
    r.scopeId = gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).scopeId
    r.name = gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).name
    r.kind = gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).kind
    r.typeName = gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).typeName
    r.diagnostic = ""
    Return 1
End Function

Function UXBSymbolResolveLexical(ByVal startScopeId As Integer, ByVal nameText As String, ByVal kindText As String, ByRef outResult As UXBSymbolResolveResult) As Integer
    UXBSymbolResolveClear outResult
    Dim idx As Integer = UXBStep3SymbolFind(nameText, kindText, startScopeId)
    If idx <> -1 Then Return UXBSymbolResolveFromIndex(idx, outResult)
    outResult.diagnostic = "symbol not found: " & nameText & " kind=" & kindText
    Return 0
End Function

Function UXBSymbolResolveAnyKindLexical(ByVal startScopeId As Integer, ByVal nameText As String, ByRef outResult As UXBSymbolResolveResult) As Integer
    Dim kinds(0 To 8) As String
    kinds(0) = SYM_VAR
    kinds(1) = SYM_PARAM
    kinds(2) = SYM_CONST
    kinds(3) = SYM_FUNCTION
    kinds(4) = SYM_SUB
    kinds(5) = SYM_TYPE
    kinds(6) = SYM_CLASS
    kinds(7) = SYM_TYPE_FIELD
    kinds(8) = SYM_CLASS_FIELD

    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To 8
        If UXBSymbolResolveLexical(startScopeId, nameText, kinds(i), outResult) <> 0 Then Return 1
    Next i

    UXBSymbolResolveClear outResult
    outResult.diagnostic = "symbol not found in any kind: " & nameText
    Return 0
End Function

Function UXBStep3ResolveSymbol(ByVal nameText As String, ByVal expectedKind As String, ByVal scopeId As Integer, ByRef typeOut As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim r As UXBSymbolResolveResult
    If UXBSymbolResolveLexical(scopeId, nameText, expectedKind, r) = 0 Then errText = r.diagnostic: Return 0
    typeOut = r.typeName
    errText = ""
    Return 1
End Function

' A symbol is only ever hash-inserted (see UXBStep3SymbolAdd) when it has a
' non-empty kind, and UXBStep3SymbolFindExactLinear itself never matches a
' non-empty query kind against a stored empty kind - so for a non-empty
' kindText the hash is authoritative and a miss really does mean "not found".
' This used to always fall through to the O(symbolCount) linear scan even on
' a hash hit-miss, and callers that probe several candidate kinds per lookup
' (e.g. UXBSymbolResolveAnyKindLexical trying 9 kinds, once per scope level)
' turned that into an O(symbolCount) scan for nearly every miss - the dominant
' cost of semantic analysis on any program with a non-trivial symbol table.
Function UXBStep3SymbolFindExact(ByVal nameText As String, ByVal kindText As String, ByVal scopeId As Integer) As Integer
    If Trim(kindText) <> "" Then
        Return UXBSymHashLookupExact(scopeId, nameText, kindText)
    End If
    Return UXBStep3SymbolFindExactLinear(nameText, kindText, scopeId)
End Function

#include once "symbol_kind.fbs"

Dim Shared gUXBStep3Symbols(Any) As UXBSymbolRecord
Dim Shared gUXBStep3SymbolCount As Integer
Dim Shared gUXBStep3SymbolCap As Integer

Private Sub UXBStep3SymbolEnsure(ByVal minCount As Integer)
    If gUXBStep3SymbolCap >= minCount Then Exit Sub
    If gUXBStep3SymbolCap < 1 Then gUXBStep3SymbolCap = 128
    Do While gUXBStep3SymbolCap < minCount
        gUXBStep3SymbolCap *= 2
    Loop
    ReDim Preserve gUXBStep3Symbols(gUXBStep3SymbolCap - 1)
End Sub

Sub UXBStep3SymbolReset()
    gUXBStep3SymbolCount = 0
    gUXBStep3SymbolCap = 0
    ReDim gUXBStep3Symbols(0)
    UXBSymHashReset
End Sub

Private Function UXBStep3SymbolFindExactLinear(ByVal nameText As String, ByVal kindText As String, ByVal scopeId As Integer) As Integer
    Dim key As String = UXBSymNormalizeName(nameText)
    Dim kindKey As String = UXBSymNormalizeKind(kindText)
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To gUXBStep3SymbolCount - 1
        If UXBSymNormalizeName(gUXBStep3Symbols(i).name) = key Then
            If kindKey = "" Or UXBSymNormalizeKind(gUXBStep3Symbols(i).kind) = kindKey Then
                If gUXBStep3Symbols(i).scopeId = scopeId Then Return i
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    Return -1
End Function

Function UXBStep3SymbolFindExact(ByVal nameText As String, ByVal kindText As String, ByVal scopeId As Integer) As Integer
    Dim idx As Integer
    If Trim(kindText) <> "" Then
        idx = UXBSymHashLookupExact(scopeId, nameText, kindText)
        If idx <> -1 Then Return idx
    End If
    Return UXBStep3SymbolFindExactLinear(nameText, kindText, scopeId)
End Function

Function UXBStep3SymbolFind(ByVal nameText As String, ByVal kindText As String, ByVal scopeId As Integer) As Integer
    Dim cur As Integer = scopeId
    Do While cur >= 0
        Dim idx As Integer = UXBStep3SymbolFindExact(nameText, kindText, cur)
        If idx <> -1 Then Return idx
        If cur <> 0 And UXBScopeIsValid(cur) = 0 Then
            ' Semantic scopes use AST node index + 1 as a stable scope id.
            ' Those ids are intentionally sparse and are not all pushed onto
            ' the runtime scope stack. They still have the global scope as
            ' their lexical parent.
            cur = 0
        Else
            cur = UXBScopeParent(cur)
        End If
    Loop
    Return -1
End Function

Function UXBStep3SymbolAdd(ByVal nameText As String, ByVal kindText As String, ByVal typeText As String, ByVal scopeId As Integer, ByVal astNode As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim key As String = UXBSymNormalizeName(nameText)
    Dim kindKey As String = UXBSymNormalizeKind(kindText)
    If key = "" Then errText = "symbol: empty name": Return -1
    If UXBStep3SymbolFindExact(key, kindKey, scopeId) <> -1 Then errText = "symbol: duplicate " & key: Return -1

    UXBStep3SymbolEnsure(gUXBStep3SymbolCount + 1)
    Dim idx As Integer = gUXBStep3SymbolCount
    gUXBStep3SymbolCount += 1

    gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).name = key
    gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).kind = kindKey
    gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).typeName = UCase(Trim(typeText))
    gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).scopeId = scopeId
    gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).astNode = astNode
    gUXBStep3Symbols(idx).flags = 0

    If kindKey <> "" Then UXBSymHashInsert scopeId, key, kindKey, idx

    errText = ""
    Return idx
End Function

#endif

Private Sub LexSource(ByRef st As LexerState)
    Dim ch As String
    Do While Not AtEnd(st)
        ch = PeekCh(st)

        If ch = Chr(13) Then
            If PeekChEx(st, 1) = Chr(10) Then
                st.cursor += 1
            Else
                AdvanceCh st, ch
            End If
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = "_" Then
            If TryConsumeLineContinuation(st) <> 0 Then
                Continue Do
            End If
        End If

        If ch = Chr(10) Then
            PushTok st, "EOL", "", st.lineNo, st.colNo
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = " " Or ch = Chr(9) Then
            AdvanceCh st, ch
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = "'" Then
            SkipComment st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If LexerAtRemCommentStartFix14(st) <> 0 Then
            SkipComment st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ch = Chr(34) Then
            ReadStringLiteral st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If IsDigit(ch) Or (ch = "&" And (UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "H" Or UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "O")) Or (ch = "%" And UCase(PeekChEx(st, 1)) = "B") Then
            ReadNumber st
            Continue Do
        End If

        If IsIdentStart(ch) Then
            ReadIdentifier st
            Continue Do
        End If

        ReadOperatorOrPunct st
    Loop

    PushTok st, "EOF", "", st.lineNo, st.colNo
    Print "DIAG_LEX rem_calls="; gDiagRemScanCalls; " rem_iters="; gDiagRemScanIters; " rem_max="; gDiagRemScanMax; " comma_calls="; gDiagCommaScanCalls; " comma_iters="; gDiagCommaScanIters; " comma_max="; gDiagCommaScanMax; " tokens="; st.tokens.count

    ' Katman ayrimi: LexerInit artik preprocessor calistirmaz.

    LexerInitFromPreprocessed st, src, sourcePath

Sub LexerInitWithLegacyPreprocess(ByRef st As LexerState, ByRef src As String, ByVal sourcePath As String = "")
    ' Geriye uyumluluk yolu. Yeni kod bu fonksiyonu kullanmamalidir.
    Dim pp As PreprocessResult
    If LexerPreprocessSourceEx(src, sourcePath, pp) = 0 Then
        LexerInitFromPreprocessed st, pp.expandedSource, sourcePath
        st.preprocessFailed = 1
        st.preprocessError = LexerPreprocessGetError()
        If Trim(st.preprocessError) = "" Then st.preprocessError = "preprocess failed"
        LexerAddDiagnostic st, "LEX_PREPROCESS_LEGACY_DEPRECATED", "LexerInitWithLegacyPreprocess deprecated; use PreprocessRun before lexer", 1, 1
        LexerAddDiagnostic st, "LEX_PREPROCESS_FAILED", st.preprocessError, 1, 1
        Exit Sub
    End If

    LexerInitFromPreprocessed st, pp.expandedSource, sourcePath
    LexerAddDiagnostic st, "LEX_PREPROCESS_LEGACY_DEPRECATED", "LexerInitWithLegacyPreprocess deprecated; use PreprocessRun before lexer", 1, 1
End Sub

Private Function ShouldTreatAsKeyword(ByRef st As LexerState, ByRef identCanonical As String) As Integer
    If KeywordRegistryLookup(identCanonical) = 0 Then Return 0

    If st.tokens.count > 0 Then
        Dim prev As Token
        prev = st.tokens.items(st.tokens.count - 1)

        ' Dot member access allows keyword-like names as identifiers (obj.then, ns.print).
        If prev.kind = "OP" And prev.lexeme = "." Then Return 0

        ' Declaration contexts expect a new user identifier.

        If prev.kind = "KEYWORD" Then
            Dim prevKw As String
            prevKw = UCase(Trim(prev.lexeme))
            Select Case prevKw
            Case "AS", "BYVAL", "BYREF", "DECLARE"
                Return 1
            End Select
            If KeywordRequiresIdentifierAfter(prev.lexeme) <> 0 Then Return 0
        End If

        ' Comma after a declaration list keeps identifier context for DIM a, b AS I32.
        If prev.kind = "OP" And prev.lexeme = "," Then
            Dim i As Integer
            Dim diagIters2 As Integer
            diagIters2 = 0
            Dim foundKw As Integer
            foundKw = -1
            For i = st.tokens.count - 2 To 0 Step -1
                diagIters2 += 1
                If st.tokens.items(i).kind = "EOL" Then Exit For
                If st.tokens.items(i).kind = "KEYWORD" Then
                    foundKw = i
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next i
            gDiagCommaScanIters += diagIters2
            gDiagCommaScanCalls += 1
            If diagIters2 > gDiagCommaScanMax Then gDiagCommaScanMax = diagIters2
            If foundKw <> -1 Then
                If KeywordRequiresIdentifierAfter(st.tokens.items(foundKw).lexeme) <> 0 Then Return 0
            End If
        End If
    End If

    Return 1
End Function

Function SemStep3SemanticTypeLayoutGate(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    errText = ""
    TypeBindingInit
    UXBStep3SymbolReset
    UXBStep3ScopeReset
    Dim ctx As UXBSemanticContext
    UXBSemanticContextInit(ctx, "X64")
    If Step3ValidateContractCoverage(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3RegisterDeclaredTypes(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateEnums(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3BindDeclarations(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateExpressions(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateStatements(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateAssignments(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateCallsAndReturns(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateFFI(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateTypeLeak(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateLayoutCoverage(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If Step3ValidateTargetCoverage(ps, errText) = 0 Then Return 0

    Dim step5 As UXBSemanticStep5Result
    Dim step5Gate As UXBSemanticStep5GateResult
    Dim step5Err As String

    If UXBSemanticStep5Run(ps, step5, step5Err) = 0 Then
        errText = step5Err
        Return 0
    End If

    If UXBSemanticStep5GateCheck(step5, step5Gate) = 0 Then
        errText = step5Gate.errorsText
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim writeErr As String
    UXBSemanticStep5WriteGateJson step5, step5Gate, "build/manual/logs/adim5_gate.json", writeErr
    UXBSemanticStep5WriteGateMarkdown step5, step5Gate, "build/manual/logs/adim5_gate.md", writeErr
    UXBSemanticStep5WriteTypeCsv step5, "build/manual/logs/adim5_type_table.csv", writeErr
    UXBSemanticStep5WriteLayoutCsv step5, "build/manual/logs/adim5_layout_report.csv", writeErr
    ' semantic_enums.json artik UXBOutputContractAfterSemantic tarafindan build/<run_id>/json/semantic/enums.json altina yazilir.

    Return 1
End Function
#endif

#ifndef UXB_SEMANTIC_STEP5_GATE_FBS

#include once "semantic_hir_layout_bridge.fbs"

Type UXBSemanticStep5GateResult
    ok As Integer
    checkedCount As Integer
    missingTypeCount As Integer
    missingSymbolCount As Integer
    missingHIRFactCount As Integer
    missingLayoutCount As Integer
    errorsText As String
End Type

Sub UXBSemanticStep5GateInit(ByRef g As UXBSemanticStep5GateResult)
    g.ok = 0
    g.checkedCount = 0
    g.missingTypeCount = 0
    g.missingSymbolCount = 0
    g.missingHIRFactCount = 0
    g.missingLayoutCount = 0
    g.errorsText = ""
End Sub

Function UXBSemanticStep5GateCheck(ByRef r As UXBSemanticStep5Result, ByRef g As UXBSemanticStep5GateResult) As Integer
    UXBSemanticStep5GateInit g
    g.checkedCount = r.typeFactCount
    Print "DIAG_STEP5GATE factCount="; r.typeTable.factCount; " elapsed="; Timer

    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To r.typeTable.factCount - 1
        If r.typeTable.facts(i).typeStatus = "MISSING_TYPE" Then
            g.missingTypeCount += 1
            g.errorsText &= "missing type at ast=" & LTrim(Str(r.typeTable.facts(i).astNode)) & " kind=" & r.typeTable.facts(i).kind & Chr(10)
        End If
    Next i

    If r.hirFactCount <= 0 Then
        g.missingHIRFactCount = 1
        g.errorsText &= "HIR fact table bos" & Chr(10)
    End If

    If r.layoutFactCount < 0 Then
        g.missingLayoutCount = 1
        g.errorsText &= "layout snapshot gecersiz" & Chr(10)
    End If

    Print "DIAG_STEP5GATE_LOOPDONE missingTypeCount="; g.missingTypeCount; " errTextLen="; Len(g.errorsText); " elapsed="; Timer
    If g.missingTypeCount = 0 And g.missingHIRFactCount = 0 And g.missingLayoutCount = 0 Then
        g.ok = 1
        Return 1
    End If
    Return 0
End Function

#endif

Function UXBSemanticStep5BuildTypeFacts(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef r As UXBSemanticStep5Result, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    errText = ""
    UXBSemanticTypeTableInit r.typeTable, ps.ast.count
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim diagSymbolFindTime As Double
    Dim diagIsNameOnlyTime As Double
    diagSymbolFindTime = 0
    diagIsNameOnlyTime = 0
    Dim diagLoopT0 As Double
    diagLoopT0 = Timer
    For i = 0 To ps.ast.count - 1
        Dim k As String = UXBStep5NodeKind(ps, i)
        r.typeTable.facts(i).astNode = i
        r.typeTable.facts(i).kind = k
        r.typeTable.facts(i).name = UXBStep5NodeName(ps, i)
        r.typeTable.facts(i).typeName = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).typeName))

        ' YAMA2-OOP-POSTFIX-2:
        ' SUPER/THIS/ME normal degisken degildir. Bunlar OOP dispatch alicilaridir.
        ' Type fact kapisi bunlari sembol tablosunda arayip MISSING_TYPE saymamali.
        If (k = "IDENT" Or k = "IDENTIFIER") Then
            Dim oopReceiverName As String
            oopReceiverName = UCase(Trim(r.typeTable.facts(i).name))
            If oopReceiverName = "SUPER" Or oopReceiverName = "THIS" Or oopReceiverName = "ME" Or oopReceiverName = "INPUT" Or oopReceiverName = "OUTPUT" Then
                r.typeTable.facts(i).typeName = TYPE_OBJECT
            End If
        End If

        If Trim(r.typeTable.facts(i).typeName) = "" Then
            Dim resolvedType As String
            If UXBStep5ResolveTypeName(ps, i, resolvedType) <> 0 Then
                r.typeTable.facts(i).typeName = resolvedType
            End If
        End If

        Dim symIdx As Integer = -1
        Dim diagT1 As Double = Timer
        If Trim(r.typeTable.facts(i).name) <> "" Then symIdx = UXBStep3SymbolFind(r.typeTable.facts(i).name, "", 0)
        diagSymbolFindTime += (Timer - diagT1)
        r.typeTable.facts(i).symbolIndex = symIdx
        If symIdx <> -1 Then r.typeTable.facts(i).scopeId = gUXBStep3Symbols(symIdx).scopeId

        Dim diagT2 As Double = Timer
        Dim diagNameOnlyResult As Integer = UXBStep5IsNameOnlyIdentContext(ps, i)
        diagIsNameOnlyTime += (Timer - diagT2)

        If Trim(r.typeTable.facts(i).typeName) <> "" Then
            r.typeTable.facts(i).typeStatus = "OK"
        ElseIf k = "CONST_STMT" Or k = "CALL_EXPR" Then
            r.typeTable.facts(i).typeStatus = "NOT_REQUIRED"
        ElseIf (k = "IDENT" Or k = "IDENTIFIER" Or k = "KEYWORD_REF") And UXBStep5IsBareFfiMetaName(r.typeTable.facts(i).name) <> 0 Then
            r.typeTable.facts(i).typeStatus = "NOT_REQUIRED"
        ElseIf (k = "IDENT" Or k = "IDENTIFIER" Or k = "KEYWORD_REF") And diagNameOnlyResult <> 0 Then
            r.typeTable.facts(i).typeStatus = "NOT_REQUIRED"
        ElseIf (k = "IDENT" Or k = "IDENTIFIER") And (UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "SLOT_CONTROL_STMT" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "TRIGGER_STMT" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "SLOT_STMT" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "SLOT_TABLE_STMT" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "SLOT_BIND_ENTRY" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "EVENT_STMT" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "THREAD_STMT" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "PIPE_STMT" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "PARALEL_STMT" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "CLASS_STMT" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "INTERFACE_STMT" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "CLASS_METHOD_DECL" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "INTERFACE_METHOD_DECL" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "CLASS_CONSTRUCTOR_DECL" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "CLASS_DESTRUCTOR_DECL" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "CLASS_OPERATOR_DECL" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "CLASS_PROPERTY_DECL" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "CLASS_FIELD_DECL" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "TYPE_REF" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "RETURN_TYPE" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "PARAM_DECL" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "CLASS_FLAG" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "CLASS_METHOD_FLAG" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "CLASS_FIELD_FLAG" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "IMPLEMENTS_REF" Or UXBStep5ParentKind(ps, i) = "EXTENDS_REF") Then

## What NOT to save in memory

- Code patterns, conventions, architecture, file paths, or project structure — these can be derived by reading the current project state.
- Git history, recent changes, or who-changed-what — `git log` / `git blame` are authoritative.
- Debugging solutions or fix recipes — the fix is in the code; the commit message has the context.
- Anything already documented in CLAUDE.md files.
- Ephemeral task details: in-progress work, temporary state, current conversation context.

These exclusions apply even when the user explicitly asks you to save. If they ask you to save a PR list or activity summary, ask what was *surprising* or *non-obvious* about it — that is the part worth keeping.

## How to save memories

Saving a memory is a two-step process:

**Step 1** — write the memory to its own file (e.g., `user_role.md`, `feedback_testing.md`) using this frontmatter format:

```markdown
---
name: {{short-kebab-case-slug}}
description: {{one-line summary, used to decide relevance in future conversations, so be specific}}
metadata:
  type: {{user, feedback, project, reference}}
---

{{memory content — for feedback/project types, structure as: rule/fact, then **Why:** and **How to apply:** lines. Link related memories with [[their-name]].}}
```

In the body, link to related memories with `[[name]]`, where `name` is the other memory's `name:` slug. Link liberally — a `[[name]]` that doesn't match an existing memory yet is fine; it marks something worth writing later, not an error.

**Step 2** — add a pointer to that file in `MEMORY.md`. `MEMORY.md` is an index, not a memory — each entry should be one line, under ~150 characters: `- [Title](file.md) — one-line hook`. It has no frontmatter. Never write memory content directly into `MEMORY.md`.

- `MEMORY.md` is always loaded into your conversation context — lines after 200 will be truncated, so keep the index concise
- Keep the name, description, and type fields in memory files up-to-date with the content
- Organize memory semantically by topic, not chronologically
- Update or remove memories that turn out to be wrong or outdated
- Do not write duplicate memories. First check if there is an existing memory you can update before writing a new one.

## When to access memories
- When memories seem relevant, or the user references prior-conversation work.
- You MUST access memory when the user explicitly asks you to check, recall, or remember.
- If the user says to *ignore* or *not use* memory: Do not apply remembered facts, cite, compare against, or mention memory content.
- Memory records can become stale over time. Use memory as context for what was true at a given point in time. Before answering the user or building assumptions based solely on information in memory records, verify that the memory is still correct and up-to-date by reading the current state of the files or resources. If a recalled memory conflicts with current information, trust what you observe now — and update or remove the stale memory rather than acting on it.

## Before recommending from memory

A memory that names a specific function, file, or flag is a claim that it existed *when the memory was written*. It may have been renamed, removed, or never merged. Before recommending it:

- If the memory names a file path: check the file exists.
- If the memory names a function or flag: grep for it.
- If the user is about to act on your recommendation (not just asking about history), verify first.

"The memory says X exists" is not the same as "X exists now."

A memory that summarizes repo state (activity logs, architecture snapshots) is frozen in time. If the user asks about *recent* or *current* state, prefer `git log` or reading the code over recalling the snapshot.

## Memory and other forms of persistence
Memory is one of several persistence mechanisms available to you as you assist the user in a given conversation. The distinction is often that memory can be recalled in future conversations and should not be used for persisting information that is only useful within the scope of the current conversation.
- When to use or update a plan instead of memory: If you are about to start a non-trivial implementation task and would like to reach alignment with the user on your approach you should use a Plan rather than saving this information to memory. Similarly, if you already have a plan within the conversation and you have changed your approach persist that change by updating the plan rather than saving a memory.
- When to use or update tasks instead of memory: When you need to break your work in current conversation into discrete steps or keep track of your progress use tasks instead of saving to memory. Tasks are great for persisting information about the work that needs to be done in the current conversation, but memory should be reserved for information that will be useful in future conversations.
